events.title: 2026-27年度「十八有藝──沙田社區演藝計劃」《身體年輪》長者舞蹈計劃──「野向公園玩藝術」工作坊
events.titleEn: 2026-27 "18dART — Community Arts Scheme in Sha Tin" — "Body in Time" Elderly Dance Project — Arts in the Park Workshops
events.address: Venues in Sha Tin district, Hong Kong
events.overview:
針對區內長者而設的全新工作坊，共八節的課堂。舞蹈藝術家藉著「藝術在公園」的主題，引領參加者重新感受自然空間、環境與身體的關係，讓長者在熟悉的公園中轉換角色，從「公園使用者」蛻變為「藝術活動參加者」。從觀察環境出發，將日常景觀轉化為舞蹈靈感，結合自身記憶與情感，創作屬於自己的身體年輪舞步。這種將身體與環境結合的全新體驗，既貼近生活又富含詩意。

工作坊(1)：
日期：29.10.2026 (四)
時間：10:00-12:00
地點：沙田公園露天劇場

stops.title: International Commerce Centre
stops.text: The International Commerce Centre is a 108-storey, 484 m supertall skyscraper in West Kowloon, Hong Kong, located atop the Elements mall and near two MTR Stations. It is the world's 13th tallest building by height, 10th tallest by number of floors, and Hong Kong's tallest, as well as the only building in the city with over 100 storeys. The official height is 484 m, which includes the 6 m tall parapets on the roof. It was the fourth tallest building in Asia, and the fourth tallest building in the world, when it was completed in 2010. The south side of the building faces Victoria Harbour.
stops.textKo: 국제상업센터 또는 인터내셔널 코머스 센터는 홍콩 가우롱에 있는 마천루를 말한다. 484미터의 높이에 118층이다. 가우롱 역 위에 위치한 유니언 스퀘어의 일부이다. 개발 명칭은 유니언 스퀘어 페이즈 7이고, 2005년 국제상업센터라는 명칭이 붙여졌다. 2010년 완공과 함께, 이 건물은 기존 홍콩 최고층 건물이었던 국제금융센터를 제치고 홍콩에서 가장 높은 건물이 되었다.

stops.title: The Cullinan
stops.text: The Cullinan is a luxury private housing estate located in the Union Square, West Kowloon, Hong Kong. The building has glass curtain walls and views of Victoria Harbour. The glass facade matches the design language of the neighbouring International Commerce Centre. This complex was named after the 3,106 carat Cullinan Diamond found in 1905; the largest gem-quality rough diamond ever found, whose constituent cut diamonds are found in the British Crown Jewels and Elizabeth II's jewels. During development under Sun Hung Kai Properties, the complex went by Kowloon Station Development Package 6 and Union Square Phase 6.

stops.title: Kowloon Park
stops.text: Kowloon Park is a large public park in Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong. It has an area of 13.3 hectares and is managed by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department.
stops.textKo: 주룽 공원은 홍콩 가우룽 짐사저이에 있는 공원이다. 강악급문화사무서가 관리하고 있다.

stops.title: Kowloon Mosque and Islamic Centre
stops.text: The Kowloon Masjid and Islamic Centre, also known as the Kowloon Mosque, is a mosque located in Kowloon, Hong Kong, China. Located in the Tsim Sha Tsui area at the intersection of Nathan Road and Haiphong Road, beside Kowloon Park, the mosque is the largest in Hong Kong and holds five prayers daily and is capable of accommodating up to 3,500 people.
stops.textKo: 주룽 모스크는 홍콩 가우룽 짐사저이 네이선 로드에 있는 모스크이다.
stops.imageCredit: Shafakt (talk) Shafak Thaika / CC BY 3.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

stops.title: Tsim Sha Tsui
stops.text: Tsim Sha Tsui, often abbreviated as TST, is an area in southern Kowloon, Hong Kong. The area is administratively part of the Yau Tsim Mong District. Tsim Sha Tsui East is a piece of land reclaimed from the Hung Hom Bay now east of Tsim Sha Tsui. The area is bounded north by Austin Road and in the east by Hong Chong Road and Cheong Wan Road. Geographically, Tsim Sha Tsui is a cape on the tip of the Kowloon Peninsula pointing towards Victoria Harbour, opposite Central.
stops.textKo: 이 문서의 광둥어 명칭은 위키백과 자체의 광둥어 표기법을 따랐으며, 통용 표기법과는 다를 수 있습니다. 침사추이(영어: Tsim Sha Tsui, 중국어: 尖沙咀, 월병: zim1 saa1 zeoi2/Jīm sā jéui, 한자음: 첨사저; 한월어: Thiêm Sa Chủy)는 홍콩에 있는 가우룽 남단의 상업지구이다.

stops.title: Hong Kong Space Museum
stops.text: The Hong Kong Space Museum is a public astronomy and space science museum located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong. Opened on 8 October 1980, it is managed by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department of the Hong Kong Government. The building is notable for its hemispherical shape, which contains a planetarium, the only one in Hong Kong. The main facilities of the museum are located in a building next to the planetarium, showcasing information about the Solar System, cosmology, and spaceflight. Accessible from Salisbury Road, it is adjacent to the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, the Hong Kong Museum of Art, and the Tsim Sha Tsui Clock Tower.
stops.textKo: 홍콩 태공관은 홍콩 짐사저이에 있는 천문학과 우주 과학 관련 박물관이다. 현재 홍콩 특별행정구 정부의 여가 및 문화 서비스 부가 관리를 맡고 있다. 이 뮤지엄은 홍콩 문화 센터와 홍콩 미술관 옆에 자리하고 있다. 이 뮤지엄은 고유한 달걀 모양의 돔을 가지고 있다. 이 돔은 약 8천 제곱미터 이상의 면적을 덮고 있다.

stops.title: Hong Kong Museum of Art
stops.text: The Hong Kong Museum of Art is the first and main art museum of Hong Kong, located on Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui. It is a public museum managed by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department of the Hong Kong Government. The HKMoA has an art collection of almost 20,000 items, and admission is free for permanent exhibitions. Its rival is the non-government-managed Hong Kong Arts Centre. These are considered to be the top two art museums in Hong Kong that dictate its discourse of art.
stops.textKo: 홍콩 예술관은 홍콩에 위치한 미술관이다. 중국 역사 유물, 동서양 미술 작품 등을 전시한다. 이 뮤지엄은 원래는 홍콩 시정국에 의해 1962년 홍콩대회당 건물에 설립되었다. 1991년 현재의 자리로 옮겨왔다. 현재 주소는 솔즈브리 로 10번지이다.

stops.title: Hong Kong Museum of History
stops.text: The Hong Kong Museum of History is a public museum that preserves Hong Kong's historical and cultural heritage. It is located next to the Hong Kong Science Museum, in Tsim Sha Tsui East, Kowloon. The collections of the museum encompass natural history, archaeology, ethnography, local history, and the development and evolution of the city's culture.
stops.textKo: 홍콩 역사박물관은 홍콩의 역사와 문화 유산을 보존한 박물관이다. 홍콩 가우룽 짐사쩌이 내 홍콩과학박물관 바로 옆에 위치해 있다. 홍콩역사박물관의 전시품들은 자연사, 고고학, 민족학, 향토사를 포괄하고 있다.

stops.title: Flagstaff House
stops.text: Flagstaff House, built in 1846, is the oldest example of colonial architecture remaining in Hong Kong. It is located at 10 Cotton Tree Drive, Central – within the Hong Kong Park. It has been a longtime residence of the Commander of the British forces in Hong Kong during colonial times. Today Flagstaff House houses the Flagstaff House Museum of Tea Ware.
stops.textKo: 플래그스태프 하우스은 중국 홍콩에 위치한 콜로니얼 양식의 건물이다. 홍콩 중서구 코튼 트리 드라이브 10번지에 위치한다. 홍콩공원 내에 있다. 1800년대에서 1930년대까지의 홍콩 식민지 기간 동안, 오랜 기간 동안 홍콩 주둔 영국 군대의 대장의 숙소로 사용되었다. 현재는, 플래그스태프 하우스 안에는 뮤지엄 오브 티 웨어가 들어서 있다.

stops.title: Hong Kong Maritime Museum
stops.text: Hong Kong Maritime Museum is a non-profit educational institution funded by the international shipping community and the government in Hong Kong. It is located at Central Pier 8, Hong Kong. The museum was established on 8 September 2005 and reopened to the public in February 2013. The museum focuses on the development of boats, ships, maritime exploration and trade, and naval warfare. While concentrating on the South China coast and its adjacent seas, its exhibits also cover global trends and provide an account of Hong Kong's maritime growth.
stops.textKo: 홍콩해사박물관은 홍콩에 있는 비영리 박물관이다. 홍콩해사박물관은 보트, 선박, 해양탐험과 무역, 해전의 발전에 초점을 둔다. 남중국해 및 인근 해역에 관련된 내용이 주를 이루지만 홍콩의 해양성장에 대한 내용도 다룬다. 홍콩해사박물관에서는 반상설전시 및 특별 전시, 교육행사 등을 진행하고 건물에 카페가 있다. 홍콩해사박물관은 전근대를 다루는 고대갤러리와 근현대를 다루는 현대갤러리 둘로 나뉘는데 시대를 아우르는 선박 모형, 그림, 도자기, 무역품 및 선박 문서들 500가지 이상을 전시한다.

stops.title: Dr Sun Yat-sen Museum
stops.text: The Dr Sun Yat-sen Museum is a museum in Central, Hong Kong dedicated to the influential Chinese revolutionary and statesman Sun Yat-sen. It is located in Kom Tong Hall, at 7 Castle Road, Central. After preparatory work undertaken by the Hong Kong Museum of History, which manages it as a branch museum, the SYSM opened to the public on 12 December 2006 to commemorate the 140th anniversary of Sun's birth.
stops.imageCredit: 文子言木 / CC BY-SA 3.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

stops.title: M+
stops.text: M+ is an art museum located in the West Kowloon Cultural District of Hong Kong. It exhibits twentieth- and twenty-first-century art encompassing visual art, design and architecture, and moving image. It opened on 12 November 2021.

stops.title: Hong Kong Science Museum
stops.text: The Hong Kong Science Museum is a public science museum in Tsim Sha Tsui East, Kowloon, Hong Kong, located opposite to the Hong Kong Museum of History.

stops.title: Hong Kong Police Museum
stops.text: The Police Museum is a museum dedicated to the history of policing in Hong Kong. The museum is housed in the former Wan Chai Gap Police Station, located at 27 Coombe Road, Wan Chai Gap, The Peak. About 1,200 exhibits are displayed in the Museum and there is generally one rotating specialised exhibition display. The revitalisation of the Police Museum commenced in mid-2020. The revitalised Museum once again opened to the public in September 2022 with a new look.

stops.title: Lei Cheng Uk Han Tomb Museum
stops.text: The Lei Cheng Uk Han Tomb Museum is a museum in Hong Kong which houses an ancient Chinese tomb. It is believed to have been built during the Eastern Han dynasty for a Chinese officer attached to the local garrison. The museum, administratively a branch of the Hong Kong Museum of History, is located at 41 Tonkin Street, in Cheung Sha Wan, Sham Shui Po District, in the northwestern part of the Kowloon Peninsula of Hong Kong.

events.title: M+博物館
events.titleEn: M+
events.overview: M+（讀作「M加」；英語：M+；英文讀作「M Plus」）是香港一所視覺文化博物館，位於九龍西九文化區，樓面總面積達125,000平方米，於2015年1月29日動工，耗資49億港元，首階段工程於2020年第二季竣工，而博物館已於2021年11月11日開幕，會繼續次階段工程。M+重點展出20世紀至21世紀的藝術、設計與建築和影像，為世界上最具規模的視覺藝術博物館之一。2010年至2016年1月行政總監為李立偉博士。李立偉於2016年1月約滿離任後，由澳洲新南威爾士州美術館副總監華安雅（Suhanya Raffel）出任。
events.overviewEn: M+ is an art museum located in the West Kowloon Cultural District of Hong Kong. It exhibits twentieth- and twenty-first-century art encompassing visual art, design and architecture, and moving image. It opened on 12 November 2021.

events.title: 古典音樂講座系列：《音樂．心處》
events.titleEn: Classical Music Lecture Series: "Music at Heart
events.address: Hong Kong Space Museum (Lecture Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
古典音樂世界從不乏個性鮮明的大師，他們的喜怒哀樂、人生際遇與奇思妙想，不僅見於軼聞，更流露於作品與演繹之中。

《音樂．心處》由聆聽出發，從八個主題切入，帶您走進大師們曾面對的處境與心境，細味多段精選錄音及錄像，體會經典名曲何以跨越時代，至今仍能觸動人心。

策劃／講者：賴建群

2026年10月7日（三）
第一集：率性與狂熱
莫扎特在《音樂玩笑》中，把業餘樂手最忌諱的走音失拍，化作討喜的笑料；李斯特則在《創世六日》變奏曲中，聯同另外五位頂尖鋼琴家同台競技，盡展一代鋼琴之王睥睨群雄的豪情與燦爛技藝。至於白遼士，更將對女演員的瘋狂單戀，昇華為《幻想交響曲》中澎湃迷幻的樂章。讓我們細味大師們率真灑脫的一面。

2026年10月14日（三）
第二集：心靈風暴
偉大的作品，往往孕育自敏感、複雜的心靈。舒曼在《狂歡節》中塑造出「弗洛雷斯坦」與「尤瑟比烏斯」兩個性格迥異的化身，呈現內心的撕裂與對話；馬勒對「第九交響曲魔咒」深感恐懼，卻仍將對生死的沉重叩問寫進第九交響曲中；史克里亞賓則試圖以《狂喜之詩》，觸碰宇宙與精神的奧秘。讓我們一同走進三位大師澎湃洶湧的內心世界，感受不安與掙扎，如何昇華為不朽的璀璨樂章！

2026年10月21日（三）
第三集：演出意外與風波
貝多芬曾因《合唱幻想曲》演出中途出錯，當場在台上暴怒喊停；史達拉汶斯基劃時代的《春之祭》首演，則引起觀眾騷動。指揮大師伯恩斯坦與鋼琴家顧爾德合作演出布拉姆斯的第一鋼琴協奏曲前，更在台上公開聲明不認同對方要求的極慢速度。誠邀您回顧這些震撼的歷史現場，看看音樂家在掌聲與噓聲中如何反應！

2026年10月28日（三）
第四集：樂譜密語
名字、格言、友情與信仰，都可以化為音符，藏進音樂裏：巴赫常以音符在五線譜上勾勒出十字架形狀，表達對信仰的至誠；舒曼、布拉姆斯與迪特里奇三人合力創作奏鳴曲，暗藏摯友「自由但孤獨」的座右銘；艾爾加則以《謎語變奏曲》描繪摯友，並留下至今未解的謎題。讓我們將名曲解碼，聽懂作曲家沒有明言的密語。

events.overviewEn: Kadoorie Farm and Botanic Garden, formerly known as Kadoorie Experimental and Extension Farm, or Kadoorie Farm, was originally set up to aid poor farmers in the New Territories in Hong Kong. It later shifted its focus to promote biodiversity conservation in Hong Kong and south China, and greater environmental awareness. It is located near Pak Ngau Shek, encompassing Kwun Yam Shan in the central New Territories; The Farm was built in a valley with streams, woodlands and terraces in 1956 by the Kadoorie Agricultural Aid Association. events.title: 孫中山紀念館
events.titleEn: Dr Sun Yat-sen Museum
events.overview: 孫中山紀念館（英語：Dr. Sun Yat-sen Museum）位於香港香港島中環衛城道7號，前身是何東胞弟何甘棠的住宅甘棠第（英語：Kom Tong Hall），於2010年11月12日（孫中山誕辰144週年）列為法定古蹟。紀念館是香港歷史博物館的分館，介紹中華民國國父孫中山先生的生平及他與香港的關係。紀念館於2006年12月12日（孫中山誕辰140周年後1個月）正式開幕。
events.overviewEn: The Dr Sun Yat-sen Museum is a museum in Central, Hong Kong dedicated to the influential Chinese revolutionary and statesman Sun Yat-sen. It is located in Kom Tong Hall, at 7 Castle Road, Central. After preparatory work undertaken by the Hong Kong Museum of History, which manages it as a branch museum, the SYSM opened to the public on 12 December 2006 to commemorate the 140th anniversary of Sun's birth.

原創互動體驗劇場！
讓觀眾跳出舞台限制，走進真正的文化古蹟，零距離體驗戲劇！

穿越百年前屏山圍村　從過去尋覓未來方向
少女一山為人生未來費煞思量，機緣巧合穿越至百年前的屏山圍村，遇上為家族未來發奮向學的子健。現代少女巧遇舊時學子，今日價值觀激撞昔日思想，又會擦出怎樣的火花？
events.overviewEn:
Ancient stories, timeless virtues

Step back in time with the protagonist and relive the rich history of Ping Shan. Watch the past come alive and be inspired by timeless virtues as you journey along the Heritage Trail.

Immerse yourself in Hong Kong’s traditional culture through promenade theatre, guided tours, and workshops in this ancient site, surrounded by monuments and historic buildings. Come discover the beauty of local history at Ping Shan.

香港八和會館第五度成為油麻地戲院的「場地伙伴」。本年度進行革新，正式易名為「優越新秀粵劇傳承計劃」。由本地粵劇名伶王超群女士、梁兆明先生、陳咏儀女士、陳鴻進先生、新劍郎先生及龍貫天先生擔任藝術總監，肩負起培訓優越新秀演員的使命。以過往14年演出培訓經驗作基礎，聚焦培育40多名優越新秀。透過藝術總監執手指導、長劇演出、新秀展演等全方位訓練，配以一系列培訓課程培育粵劇新秀成長，向觀眾展示香港粵劇新秀演員的實力，將這項本土非物質文化遺產發揚光大。計劃正邁向令人期待的革新，本年度將籌辦66場粵劇演出及活動，展示粵劇文化及藝術風采。

「天地神袛同鑒察，重盟百世好姻緣」
佘塘關遭兵困，惟佘洪不忿求助於楊袞，其女佘賽花命侍女排雲發書予楊繼業，計請楊家軍解圍，二老冰釋前嫌。楊佘兩軍登山狩獵，繼業與賽花互相傾慕，楊袞向佘洪提親。惟賽花因太后作主許配孫建之子，訪繼業欲謀對策，反被誤會，佘洪唯有決定比武定親。賽花為免錯配姻緣，先將孫炎打敗，再詐敗予繼業，氣煞孫建。崔應龍從中挑撥，致令三家將帥不和，賽花被騙說繼業殺其父及幼弟佘勛，遂追至七星破廟，反被繼業所擒。最後楊佘兩人能否重修舊好？
events.overviewEn:
The Chinese Artists Association of Hong Kong has been appointed as the venue partner for the Yau Ma Tei Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme for the fifth time. This year marks a significant revitalization as the initiative is officially renamed "Elite Young Talents Cantonese Opera Legacy Program."

Renowned Cantonese opera artists Ms. Wong Chiu-kwan, Mr. Leung Siu-ming, Ms. Chan Wing-yee, Mr. Roger Chan, Mr. Sun Kim-long, and Mr. Loong Koon-tin serve as Artistic Directors, shouldering the mission of training exceptional young performers. Building upon 14 years of performance and training experience, the program focuses on nurturing over 40 elite young talents.

Through comprehensive training—including direct mentorship from the Artistic Directors, full-length opera performances, Young Talent Showcases, and a series of training courses—the program aims to foster the growth of rising stars.…

events.titleEn: Flagstaff House
events.overview: 茶具文物館（英語：Museum of Tea Ware），位於香港香港島中西區中環紅棉路10號，即香港公園內。文物館為香港康樂及文化事務署轄下的博物館之一，以及香港藝術館的分館，館內展出各种中国茶具及茶藝相關文物。文物館前身是駐港英軍司令的官邸，因而擁有旗桿屋（英語：Flagstaff House）之稱。建筑物为香港現存歷史最悠久的西式建築，屬希臘復興式建築風格，設計簡潔，見證香港百年歷史，歷史價值尚高，已列為香港法定古蹟。
events.overviewEn: Flagstaff House, built in 1846, is the oldest example of colonial architecture remaining in Hong Kong. It is located at 10 Cotton Tree Drive, Central – within the Hong Kong Park. It has been a longtime residence of the Commander of the British forces in Hong Kong during colonial times. Today Flagstaff House houses the Flagstaff House Museum of Tea Ware.

events.title: 香港動植物公園
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Zoological and Botanical Gardens
events.placeEn: Hong Kong Zoological and Botanical Gardens
events.address: 香港中環雅賓利道
events.overview: 香港動植物公園（英語：Hong Kong Zoological and Botanical Gardens），簡稱「動植物公園」，俗稱「兵頭花園」，是香港最早建立的公園，位於香港島中環雅賓利道，並被羅便臣道、己連拿利、上亞厘畢道及花園道等道路環繞，1860年動工興建，1864年局部開放，1871年全面落成。公園早期以植物為主，故名為植物公園，其後園中飼養的動物日增，便於1975年改名為香港動植物公園。佔地5.6公頃，公園的正門設在雅賓利道。香港動植物公園鄰近香港公園，同樣為香港旅遊景點之一。
events.overviewEn: The Hong Kong Zoological and Botanical Gardens is one of the oldest zoological and botanical centres in the world, and the oldest park in Hong Kong. Founded in 1864, its first stage was opened to the public in 1871. It occupies an area of 5.6 hectares in Central, on the northern slope of Victoria Peak. Similar to Hong Kong Park, Hong Kong Zoological and Botanical Gardens provides a natural environment and atmosphere.

events.place: 香港抗戰及海防博物館
events.placeEn: Hong Kong Museum of the War of Resistance and Coastal Defence
events.address: 香港筲箕灣東喜道175號
events.overview: 香港抗戰及海防博物館（英語：Hong Kong Museum of the War of Resistance and Coastal Defence），舊稱香港海防博物館（英語：Hong Kong Museum of Coastal Defence），位於香港東區筲箕灣東喜道175至177號，全館面積約34,200平方米，原本為香港歷史博物館分館之一，由康樂及文化事務署管理，是由逾百年歷史的舊鯉魚門炮台改建而成。該博物館于2024年9月3日更名為「抗戰及海防博物館」並成為屬立館屬，不再被列為香港歷史博物館的分館。
events.overviewEn: The Hong Kong Museum of the War of Resistance and Coastal Defence, formerly known as the Hong Kong Museum of Coastal Defence, is a public museum in Hong Kong, located in a former coastal defence fort overlooking the Lei Yue Mun channel, near Shau Kei Wan on Hong Kong Island. The fort was built by the British in 1887, intended to defend the eastern approaches to Victoria Harbour. It was previously a branch museum of the Hong Kong Museum of History. The total area of the HKMWRCD is 34,200 square metres.

events.title: 香港文化博物館
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Heritage Museum
events.overview: 香港文化博物館（英語：Hong Kong Heritage Museum）位於香港新界沙田文林路1號，是由康樂及文化事務署管理的一所綜合性博物館，內容涵蓋歷史、藝術和文化等範疇。博物館耗資超過8億港元興建，2000年12月17日正式對外開放。館內設有12個展覽場館，陳列面積達7,500平方米，於當時為香港最大型的博物館。2009/10年度總參觀人數達到479,000人次。
events.overviewEn: The Hong Kong Heritage Museum is a public museum of history, art and culture in Sha Tin, Hong Kong, located beside the Shing Mun River. The museum opened on 16 December 2000 and is managed by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department of the Hong Kong Government. The six permanent exhibitions and the original temporary exhibits were designed by design firm Reich+Petch along with Lord Cultural Resources. The museum building is the largest in the region, and can accommodate up to 6,000 visitors.
events.overviewKo: 홍콩 문화박물관은 홍콩의 역사, 미술, 문화를 개관하는 박물관이다. 2000년 12월 16일 문을 열였으며 상문 강변에 자리해 있다. 홍콩 특별행정구 정부 산하 부처인 사틴 강락급문화사무서가 운영한다. 기획전시관 여섯 곳과 상설전시관으로 이루어진 홍콩 문화박물관은 레이크+페스와 로드 컬추럴 리소스가 함께 설계했다.

events.title: 香港歷史博物館
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Museum of History
events.overview: 香港歷史博物館（英語：Hong Kong Museum of History）位於香港九龍尖沙咀漆咸道南100號，現由康樂及文化事務署管理，共耗資3億9千萬港元興建，於1998年9月28日開放。建築設計由建築署委托巴馬丹拿公司承辦，採用建築師威拿（E. Verner Johnson）的概念，總承建商為宏宗建築有限公司。 香港歷史博物館為香港居民及遊客介紹香港的歷史，展覽內容包括香港及南中國一帶的考古發現、珍貴文物及資料等；涵蓋自然生態、民間風俗及歷史發展，向參觀者呈現香港四億年來的生態環境及歷史故事。博物館總樓面面積18,500平方米，常設展廳佔地7,000平方米，並經常舉辦包括香港掌故等主題展覽。
events.overviewEn: The Hong Kong Museum of History is a public museum that preserves Hong Kong's historical and cultural heritage. It is located next to the Hong Kong Science Museum, in Tsim Sha Tsui East, Kowloon. The collections of the museum encompass natural history, archaeology, ethnography, local history, and the development and evolution of the city's culture.
events.overviewKo: 홍콩 역사박물관은 홍콩의 역사와 문화 유산을 보존한 박물관이다. 홍콩 가우룽 짐사쩌이 내 홍콩과학박물관 바로 옆에 위치해 있다. 홍콩역사박물관의 전시품들은 자연사, 고고학, 민족학, 향토사를 포괄하고 있다.

events.title: 香港流行文化節2026：幸會25歲──香港電影資料館珍藏展 （香港電影資料館二十五周年誌慶節目）
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Pop Culture Festival 2026: Hong Kong Film Archive Stories: Treasure Hunting for 25 Years (Celebrating the 25th Anniversary of the Hong Kong Film Archive)
events.place: 香港文化博物館 (專題展覽館一及二)
events.address: Hong Kong Heritage Museum (Thematic Galleries 1 & 2), Hong Kong
events.overview:
香港電影資料館踏入25周年！為與更多觀眾一同慶祝這個重要時刻，資料館首度於香港文化博物館精心呈獻「珍藏展」！從館藏超過130萬件的珍貴電影文物中，嚴選極具歷史與文化價值的瑰寶，帶領觀眾重溫銀幕光影的經典時代。

穿越閃閃發亮的「25歲影人照片隧道」，走進早期香港電影的藏寶庫，從歷年預告片速讀電影演變，欣賞絢爛奪目的戲服華裳，更可一睹影人慷慨捐贈的榮譽獎項「大觀園」！

在口述歷史區聆聽影人親述心聲，壓軸重溫資料館出版與活動的精彩足跡。多項互動裝置讓觀眾穿越時空，近距離感受香港電影文化的獨特魅力。誠邀大家蒞臨，共享這場超乎想像的光影生日盛會！

香港文化博物館協辦
events.overviewEn:
The Hong Kong Film Archive marks its 25th anniversary with a special exhibition at the Hong Kong Heritage Museum. Drawing on more than 1.3 million film artefacts, the display offers a carefully curated selection of items of notable historical and cultural significance, inviting visitors to revisit the golden age of the screen.

Visitors enter via the dazzling photo tunnel of Hong Kong stars and step into a treasury of early Hong Kong cinema. A brisk sequence of historical trailers charts the medium’s development, while resplendent costumes highlight the craft of filmmaking. The “Hall of Honours” showcases awards generously donated by industry figures.

Listen to filmmakers’ deep and incisive reflections on local cinema, then explore the Archive’s publications and timeline of activities. Fun interactive installations connect audiences across time and space — this is a birthday bash not…
events.source: LCSD 康文署 – Presented by Hong Kong Film Archive (DATA.GOV.HK)
events.posterCredit: 香港文化博物館 — Wing1990hk / CC BY 3.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

events.title: 香港科學館
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Science Museum
events.overview: 香港科學館（英語：Hong Kong Science Museum），簡稱科學館，是香港一所以科學為主題的博物館，位於九龍尖沙咀東，毗鄰香港歷史博物館，現由康樂及文化事務署管理。2005年全年，香港科學館參觀人數達92.7萬人次，是康文署轄下十多間博物館中，每年平均參觀人次最多的博物館。 到2015/16財務年度則接待多達1,124,887人次。 香港科學館樓高4層（包括地下），共16個展區，佔地2.7萬平方米，樓面總面積為13500平方米，擁有約500件展品，覆蓋各不同種類之科學，其中約十分之一展品可供參觀者親自操作。
events.overviewEn: The Hong Kong Science Museum is a public science museum in Tsim Sha Tsui East, Kowloon, Hong Kong, located opposite to the Hong Kong Museum of History.
events.posterCredit: WiNG / CC BY 3.0 (Wikimedia Commons)
events.source: Wikidata / Wikipedia (CC0 / CC BY-SA)

events.title: 香港藝術館
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Museum of Art
events.overview: 香港藝術館（英語：Hong Kong Museum of Art，簡寫：HKMOA），位於香港九龍油尖旺區尖沙咀梳士巴利道10號，是康樂及文化事務署轄下的博物館之一，原址位於中環香港大會堂頂層，1991年遷入，是香港展覽本地、中國及世界各地的藝術品的主要場地，館藏逾17,000件、涵蓋中國書畫、古代文物、外銷藝術、畫作、現代藝術及香港藝術家的創作成果等。香港藝術館不時舉行各類型的藝術展覽。
events.overviewEn: The Hong Kong Museum of Art is the first and main art museum of Hong Kong, located on Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui. It is a public museum managed by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department of the Hong Kong Government. The HKMoA has an art collection of almost 20,000 items, and admission is free for permanent exhibitions. Its rival is the non-government-managed Hong Kong Arts Centre.
events.overviewKo: 홍콩 예술관은 홍콩에 위치한 미술관이다. 중국 역사 유물, 동서양 미술 작품 등을 전시한다. 이 뮤지엄은 원래는 홍콩 시정국에 의해 1962년 홍콩대회당 건물에 설립되었다. 1991년 현재의 자리로 옮겨왔다.

events.title: 《薛寶釵，這個人》
events.titleEn: The Xuebaochai Moments
events.address: Kwai Tsing Theatre (Auditorium), Hong Kong
events.overview:
林奕華可能是經歷曹雪芹的《紅樓夢》搬上舞台最多次的香港劇場導演。始於1986年身為進念．二十面體創作人員的《石頭記》，2011年的《賈寶玉》，2014年的《紅樓夢What Is Sex》，2021年的《寶玉，你好》。來到2026年，在《石頭記》的四十年後，他的第五度「紅樓夢劇場之旅」，是《薛寶釵，這個人》。

為什麼是《薛寶釵，這個人》？林奕華給出三個答案：

第一，「紅樓夢」從女媧補天開始，那三萬六千五百零一塊的石頭，化身成玉，跟著神瑛使者化身賈寶玉，薛寶釵和「他」的關係，儼如人間的女媧，也是在「補」。

第二，有「補」必有「洞」，必有「縫」，「紅樓夢」中的人際關係錯綜複雜，薛寶釵的存在，既是為了解決問題，也是問題所在。

第三，有人的地方就有矛盾紛爭，薛寶釵作客大觀園，還是捲入是非角力的漩渦，有關「薛寶釵這個人」的言行作為，是千真萬確，是捕風捉影？

誰不想一生都在別人眼中看見像「薛寶釵」那樣近乎完美的自己？誰又想一生都像「薛寶釵」，活在別人對自己的各種評斷甚至誤解之中？

《薛寶釵，這個人》將把薛寶釵的「生平」，放在現代人的「觀看」模式和情境中上演，飾演「薛寶釵」的是劇中的一群「演員」，飾演這些「演員」的，有李心潔、路嘉欣、時一修、趙逸嵐、王宏元、黃人傑、黃峻傑、羅𤋮彥和祝家樂。現場鋼琴伴奏阿超。

《薛寶釵，這個人》的「生平」，將由九首陳建騏作曲，林奕華作詞的歌曲串起，它們是《天衣無縫》、《終身誤》、《別叫我姐姐》、《太多男孩》、《難得我多情如此》、《Frozen》、《第四十五回》、《他的最愛》及《薛寶釵，這個人》。

編劇 / 導演 / 作詞：林奕華
主演：李心潔
演出：時一修、路嘉欣、趙逸嵐 、王宏元、 黃人傑、 黃峻傑、 羅熙彥、祝家樂
音樂總監及作曲：陳建騏
現場鋼琴：阿超

events.title: 2026社區文化大使—人木「《止戈為武》合家歡音樂劇」巡迴演出
events.titleEn: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: The People's Theatre "Family Musical 'The True Martial Way'" Touring Performances
events.address: Venues in North district, Hong Kong
events.overview: 《止戈為武》是一部融合中華武術和美妙樂韻的原創合家歡音樂劇。演出以「以武入樂，以樂全心」為核心思想，透過動人的旋律、震撼的武打場面和溫馨幽默的劇情，傳遞「以武止戈、以和為貴」的傳統智慧。劇中武術剛柔並濟，巧妙結合音樂與舞蹈，呈現力量與慈悲兩種理念的平衡；音樂創作則融匯國樂精髓與現代編曲，既有激昂的武打配樂，也有溫馨的親子對唱，令不同年齡的觀眾產生共鳴。本劇以視聽盛宴承載文化內涵，寓教於樂，適合全家欣賞。這個計劃亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/ccpo/index.html。如遇特殊情況，主辦機構保留更換節目、表演者、講者及導師的權利。
events.overviewEn: 'The True Martial Way' is an original family musical that fuses Chinese martial arts with captivating melodies. Guided by the core principle of "integrating martial arts into music and filling the heart with music", the performance presents touching tunes, striking martial arts scenes and a warm and humorous plot to convey the traditional Chinese wisdom of "ending conflict through martial arts and valuing harmony above all". The performance showcases martial arts that balance strength with grace, strength with softness, blending music and dance to illustrate the harmony between the philosophies of power and compassion. The music integrates traditional Chinese music with modern arrangements, featuring uplifting martial fight scores as well as tender parent-child duets which resonate with audiences of all ages. It is a feast for the senses, a carrier of cultural essence, and an…
events.source: LCSD 康文署 – Presented by The People's Theatre (DATA.GOV.HK)
events.posterCredit: www.facebook.com (og:image)

We welcome you to join as villagers to share joy and express yourselves wholeheartedly through drumming and dance.

events.title: 中國內地電影展 2026
events.titleEn: Chinese Mainland Film Panorama 2026
events.place: 香港電影資料館 (電影院)
events.address: Hong Kong Film Archive (Cinema), Hong Kong
events.overview:
自1997年起，中國內地電影展已歷經廿九年寒暑，每一年記錄着時代的脈動，更見證着一代代電影人的萌芽與綻放。

我們深信，所有震撼人心的銀幕史詩，都始於最初那幾秒不甘平庸的閃念。今年我們將以「短片啟航，長片盛放」為題，完整呈現內地導演「從零到一」的創作心路，本屆影展特別加推「長短片單元」，冀令觀眾能親眼目睹創作者們千里之行始於足下的破局軌跡，鏡頭後摸索最初的熾熱與悸動。

開幕電影《浪浪山小妖怪》，由爆紅短片《中國奇譚之小妖怪的夏天》延伸而來，幾隻無名小妖組成「西天取經團」，踏上一場笑中有淚的冒險，道盡職場草根的生存法則與韌性；《火鍋英雄》延續導演楊慶在大學戲劇作業中的密閉空間敘事方式，引爆一場夾雜兄弟情、舊日戀情和黑幫衝突的荒誕風暴；黑色犯罪喜劇《受益人》展現了導演申奧從拍攝多套短片累積的扎實功力，用荒誕騙局勾勒底層人物的困頓與溫情；聚焦京劇少年變聲困惑的《倒倉》，從 15 分鐘短片發酵，折射出青春期關於性別認同與對未來的徬徨。

奇幻大作《從21世紀安全撤離》延續導演李陽一貫以來富視覺衝擊的風格，用遊戲化敘事勾勒一場永不結束的夏日大冒險；藏族女導演崗珍作品《一個夜晚與三個夏天》以現代拉薩的年輕視角，鋪陳一段關於記憶與成長的微妙蛻變。獲得國際影展肯定的《喜喪》，從同名短片深耕演化，以沉鬱的紀實力量直視農村老齡化與傳統孝道的巨大鴻溝。

《老槍》則將視線拉回80年代廠區，看退役神槍手如何在時代陣痛中迎來終極爆發；《蒼山》由 28 分鐘短片擴展而來，細膩呈現中年女性離鄉打工，在物是人非的環境下追尋心靈自由的時代鄉愁；口碑極佳，二維原創國產動畫標桿的《羅小黑戰記II》，延續了前作標誌性的清新治癒畫風與冷幽默，開啟了新一段充滿未知與危機的冒險之旅。

原為廣州美術學院的學生畢業短片《落凡塵》，經超過二千名動畫師的努力，嶄新的國風設計配合視覺特技，把「牛郎織女」的延伸故事構建成蕩氣迴腸的動畫大片；更有創下票房奇蹟，從備受讚譽的舞台小品蛻變為感人至深的喜劇長片《你好，李煥英》。…
events.overviewEn:
Since 1997, the Chinese Mainland Film Panorama has spanned 29 years, capturing the pulse of changing times while witnessing generations of filmmakers take root and flourish.

Every great film begins with a spark of imagination. This year, under the theme “The Journey from Shorts to Features”, we spotlight Mainland filmmakers and their creative paths, with a special section tracing their journey from early short experiments to feature films.

Opening film Nobody is an extension of the hit short of the same title from the Yao-Chinese Folktales. It follows a group of nameless little monsters on a humorous yet touching adventure that reflects the struggles and resilience of ordinary workers. Chongqing Hot Pot captures the essence of a confined-space setting that originated as a university assignment, while black comedy My Dear Liar reflects director Shen Ao’s experience gained through…

events.title: 亞藝無疆2026︰眉月製作《圓》
events.titleEn: Asia+ Festival 2026: "Teh Dar" by Lune Production
events.address: Tuen Mun Town Hall (Auditorium), Hong Kong
events.overview:
當代馬戲劇場《圓》帶領觀眾走進越南中部雲霧繚繞的高原深處，感受生機勃發的古老文化。

「Teh Dar」在西原格賀族的語言中意為「繞圈而行」，寓意生生不息。紅色舞台象徵西原的紅土地貌，雜技演員在千變萬化的竹藝結構上表演高空驚險技藝。先祖的神話在密林間流傳，千年不滅的營火，點燃壯闊山巒之魂，一一呈現觀眾眼前。現場樂隊以鑼鉦、水牛角、竹琴和象腳鼓等傳統樂器，演奏被列為聯合國非物質文
化遺產的西原鑼鉦文化。

《圓》神秘而充滿力量，歌頌經過時間洗練，依然歷久常新的傳統文化。眉月製作素有「越南版太陽馬戲團」的美譽，此作品於歐洲巡演後現首度登上香港舞台，不容錯過。
events.overviewEn:
Deep in the mist-shrouded highlands of Vietnam, ancient traditions pulse with vitality. Teh Dar is a celebration of mountain culture and wild beauty in the form of contemporary acrobatic theatre.

In the K’Ho language, “Teh Dar” means “going in circles”, evoking the eternal cycle of life. On a stage reminiscent of the region’s distinctive red soil landscape, acrobatic
performers conjure scenes of ancestral legend through daring aerial feats on evolving bamboo structures. Stories once sung deep within forests, echoed across soaring heights, and whispered around fires for generations now unfold vividly on stage. A live ensemble plays traditional instruments including gong, buffalo horn, T’rung and long drum, rooted in the Gong Culture of these highland communities, a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

Enigmatic, explosive and visceral, Teh Dar is a testament to humanity…

events.title: 油麻地戲院場地伙伴計劃- 優越新秀粵劇傳承計劃 2026-27 粵劇演出《辭郎洲》
events.titleEn: Yau Ma Tei Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme-Elite Young Talents Cantonese Opera Legacy Program 2026-27 "Cantonese Opera Performance - Farewell, My Husband
events.address: Ko Shan Theatre (New Wing Auditorium), Hong Kong
events.overview:
香港八和會館第五度成為油麻地戲院的「場地伙伴」。本年度進行革新，正式易名為「優越新秀粵劇傳承計劃」。由本地粵劇名伶王超群女士、梁兆明先生、陳咏儀女士、陳鴻進先生、新劍郎先生及龍貫天先生擔任藝術總監，肩負起培訓優越新秀演員的使命。以過往14年演出培訓經驗作基礎，聚焦培育40多名優越新秀。透過藝術總監執手指導、長劇演出、新秀展演等全方位訓練，配以一系列培訓課程培育粵劇新秀成長，向觀眾展示香港粵劇新秀演員的實力，將這項本土非物質文化遺產發揚光大。計劃正邁向令人期待的革新，本年度將籌辦66場粵劇演出及活動，展示粵劇文化及藝術風采。

「三軍慷慨吞胡虜，壯士狂歌舉義旗」
南宋末年，前潮州統領張達，偕妻子陳璧娘，隱居潮州，指導族人練軍整旅。欽差傳來聖旨，望張達率義軍勤王。眾鄉親決心報國，說服張達不計前嫌，帶軍出征。數月後，前線告急，璧娘率眾前往闖敵軍陣營。欽差變節事仇，推出張達脅令歸降。眾人不敢屈服，張達勉勵各人再圖舉義，繼續抗元。張達為救眾人，力抗元兵，以身殉國。元軍持續進迫，璧娘勉勵鄉親承其志，壯烈犧牲以保眾人安全。
events.overviewEn:
The Chinese Artists Association of Hong Kong has been appointed as the venue partner for the Yau Ma Tei Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme for the fifth time. This year marks a significant revitalization as the initiative is officially renamed "Elite Young Talents Cantonese Opera Legacy Program."

Renowned Cantonese opera artists Ms. Wong Chiu-kwan, Mr. Leung Siu-ming, Ms. Chan Wing-yee, Mr. Roger Chan, Mr. Sun Kim-long, and Mr. Loong Koon-tin serve as Artistic Directors, shouldering the mission of training exceptional young performers. Building upon 14 years of performance and training experience, the program focuses on nurturing over 40 elite young talents.

Through comprehensive training—including direct mentorship from the Artistic Directors, full-length opera performances, Young Talent Showcases, and a series of training courses—the program aims to foster the growth of rising stars.…

events.overview: 《止戈為武》是一部融合中華武術和美妙樂韻的原創合家歡音樂劇。演出以「以武入樂，以樂全心」為核心思想，透過動人的旋律、震撼的武打場面和溫馨幽默的劇情，傳遞「以武止戈、以和為貴」的傳統智慧。劇中武術剛柔並濟，巧妙結合音樂與舞蹈，呈現力量與慈悲兩種理念的平衡；音樂創作則融匯國樂精髓與現代編曲，既有激昂的武打配樂，也有溫馨的親子對唱，令不同年齡的觀眾產生共鳴。本劇以視聽盛宴承載文化內涵，寓教於樂，適合全家欣賞。這個計劃亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/ccpo/index.html。如遇特殊情況，主辦機構保留更換節目、表演者、講者及導師的權利。
events.overviewEn: 'The True Martial Way' is an original family musical that fuses Chinese martial arts with captivating melodies. Guided by the core principle of "integrating martial arts into music and filling the heart with music", the performance presents touching tunes, striking martial arts scenes and a warm and humorous plot to convey the traditional Chinese wisdom of "ending conflict through martial arts and valuing harmony above all". The performance showcases martial arts that balance strength with grace, strength with softness, blending music and dance to illustrate the harmony between the philosophies of power and compassion. The music integrates traditional Chinese music with modern arrangements, featuring uplifting martial fight scores as well as tender parent-child duets which resonate with audiences of all ages. It is a feast for the senses, a carrier of cultural essence, and an…
events.source: LCSD 康文署 – Presented by The People's Theatre (DATA.GOV.HK)

events.title: 2026社區文化大使: 匯樂團「古典亦時尚」社區音樂會
events.titleEn: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: Music Assembly 'Classic Vogue' Community Concert
events.address: Venues in Tuen Mun district, Hong Kong
events.overview: 在歐洲古典音樂的發展史中，不乏借鑒民間及東方音樂而創作的偉大作品，本計劃以不同時期古典作曲家的創作風格為靈感，融合中國傳統及現代音樂元素，由結合了歐洲古典樂器、中國傳統樂器及現代電子樂器的樂團，透過此融合音樂節目，在社區推廣香港原創音樂的品牌形象。
events.overviewEn: The history of European classical music includes many great works that incorporates folk and Eastern musical elements. This project draws inspiration from the compositional styles of different periods, fusing traditional Chinese and contemporary elements to create a crossover programme for an ensemble that blends European classical instruments, traditional Chinese instruments, and modern electronic instruments, promoting Hong Kong's original music brand throughout the community.
events.source: LCSD 康文署 – Presented by Music Assembly (DATA.GOV.HK)

events.address: Venues in Wan Chai district, Hong Kong
events.overview: 「節拍部落」邀請你踏上一場獨特的遊牧旅程，感受節拍的力量與西非音樂的魅力。置身於這個充滿活力的部落中，讓環保藝術與深厚的文化氛圍交織，點燃每個人的創意火花。我們歡迎你化身村民，通過鼓樂和舞蹈，全心全意地分享喜悅和表達自我。
events.overviewEn: The Rhythm Tribe invites you on a nomadic journey to experience the power of rhythm and the charm of West African music. This vibrant community sparks creativity through recycled arts and a rich cultural atmosphere. We welcome you to join as villagers to share joy and express yourselves wholeheartedly through drumming and dance.

events.title: 中國內地電影展 2026
events.titleEn: Chinese Mainland Film Panorama 2026
events.address: Hong Kong Space Museum (Lecture Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
自1997年起，中國內地電影展已歷經廿九年寒暑，每一年記錄着時代的脈動，更見證着一代代電影人的萌芽與綻放。

我們深信，所有震撼人心的銀幕史詩，都始於最初那幾秒不甘平庸的閃念。今年我們將以「短片啟航，長片盛放」為題，完整呈現內地導演「從零到一」的創作心路，本屆影展特別加推「長短片單元」，冀令觀眾能親眼目睹創作者們千里之行始於足下的破局軌跡，鏡頭後摸索最初的熾熱與悸動。

開幕電影《浪浪山小妖怪》，由爆紅短片《中國奇譚之小妖怪的夏天》延伸而來，幾隻無名小妖組成「西天取經團」，踏上一場笑中有淚的冒險，道盡職場草根的生存法則與韌性；《火鍋英雄》延續導演楊慶在大學戲劇作業中的密閉空間敘事方式，引爆一場夾雜兄弟情、舊日戀情和黑幫衝突的荒誕風暴；黑色犯罪喜劇《受益人》展現了導演申奧從拍攝多套短片累積的扎實功力，用荒誕騙局勾勒底層人物的困頓與溫情；聚焦京劇少年變聲困惑的《倒倉》，從 15 分鐘短片發酵，折射出青春期關於性別認同與對未來的徬徨。

奇幻大作《從21世紀安全撤離》延續導演李陽一貫以來富視覺衝擊的風格，用遊戲化敘事勾勒一場永不結束的夏日大冒險；藏族女導演崗珍作品《一個夜晚與三個夏天》以現代拉薩的年輕視角，鋪陳一段關於記憶與成長的微妙蛻變。獲得國際影展肯定的《喜喪》，從同名短片深耕演化，以沉鬱的紀實力量直視農村老齡化與傳統孝道的巨大鴻溝。

《老槍》則將視線拉回80年代廠區，看退役神槍手如何在時代陣痛中迎來終極爆發；《蒼山》由 28 分鐘短片擴展而來，細膩呈現中年女性離鄉打工，在物是人非的環境下追尋心靈自由的時代鄉愁；口碑極佳，二維原創國產動畫標桿的《羅小黑戰記II》，延續了前作標誌性的清新治癒畫風與冷幽默，開啟了新一段充滿未知與危機的冒險之旅。

原為廣州美術學院的學生畢業短片《落凡塵》，經超過二千名動畫師的努力，嶄新的國風設計配合視覺特技，把「牛郎織女」的延伸故事構建成蕩氣迴腸的動畫大片；更有創下票房奇蹟，從備受讚譽的舞台小品蛻變為感人至深的喜劇長片《你好，李煥英》。…
events.overviewEn:
Since 1997, the Chinese Mainland Film Panorama has spanned 29 years, capturing the pulse of changing times while witnessing generations of filmmakers take root and flourish.

Every great film begins with a spark of imagination. This year, under the theme “The Journey from Shorts to Features”, we spotlight Mainland filmmakers and their creative paths, with a special section tracing their journey from early short experiments to feature films.

Opening film Nobody is an extension of the hit short of the same title from the Yao-Chinese Folktales. It follows a group of nameless little monsters on a humorous yet touching adventure that reflects the struggles and resilience of ordinary workers. Chongqing Hot Pot captures the essence of a confined-space setting that originated as a university assignment, while black comedy My Dear Liar reflects director Shen Ao’s experience gained through…

events.title: 油麻地戲院場地伙伴計劃- 優越新秀粵劇傳承計劃 2026-27 粵劇演出《紅了櫻桃碎了心》
events.titleEn: Yau Ma Tei Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme-Elite Young Talents Cantonese Opera Legacy Program 2026-27 "Cantonese Opera Performance - Red Cherries and a Broken Heart
events.address: Ko Shan Theatre (New Wing Auditorium), Hong Kong
events.overview:
香港八和會館第五度成為油麻地戲院的「場地伙伴」。本年度進行革新，正式易名為「優越新秀粵劇傳承計劃」。由本地粵劇名伶王超群女士、梁兆明先生、陳咏儀女士、陳鴻進先生、新劍郎先生及龍貫天先生擔任藝術總監，肩負起培訓優越新秀演員的使命。以過往14年演出培訓經驗作基礎，聚焦培育40多名優越新秀。透過藝術總監執手指導、長劇演出、新秀展演等全方位訓練，配以一系列培訓課程培育粵劇新秀成長，向觀眾展示香港粵劇新秀演員的實力，將這項本土非物質文化遺產發揚光大。計劃正邁向令人期待的革新，本年度將籌辦66場粵劇演出及活動，展示粵劇文化及藝術風采。

「恩不認，情不認，離合悲歡天注定」
蕭桃紅接得兄長蕭懷雅發達家書，與父蕭亞梓結束賣唱和樂器生意，臨行遇名聞天下的樂師趙珠璣。懷雅因救富家公子孔桂芬，與其妹孔艷芳成婚，更為媒撮合桃紅與桂芬。懷雅營商失敗被囚，獲救後又與桂芬起爭執，互相休妻，人財兩失。桃紅再遇珠璣，欲成名以報復桂芬，隱瞞身世隨珠璣習藝。一年後，桃紅終一曲成名，可珠璣為助她而病重，得悉其身世後更吐血身亡……
events.overviewEn:
The Chinese Artists Association of Hong Kong has been appointed as the venue partner for the Yau Ma Tei Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme for the fifth time. This year marks a significant revitalization as the initiative is officially renamed "Elite Young Talents Cantonese Opera Legacy Program."

Renowned Cantonese opera artists Ms. Wong Chiu-kwan, Mr. Leung Siu-ming, Ms. Chan Wing-yee, Mr. Roger Chan, Mr. Sun Kim-long, and Mr. Loong Koon-tin serve as Artistic Directors, shouldering the mission of training exceptional young performers. Building upon 14 years of performance and training experience, the program focuses on nurturing over 40 elite young talents.

Through comprehensive training—including direct mentorship from the Artistic Directors, full-length opera performances, Young Talent Showcases, and a series of training courses—the program aims to foster the growth of rising stars.…

events.title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：貝托祺的布魯赫納四
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Tarmo Peltokoski Conducts Bruckner 4
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview: 布魯赫納的「浪漫」交響曲猶如一幅中世紀的壯麗畫卷，在音樂中緩緩展開。以睿智、自信及對樂譜的絕對尊重見稱，貝托祺為布魯赫納恢宏的音樂構想注入清新而紮實的詮釋，讓綿長的結構自然說話。在這位新任音樂總監的帶領下，港樂遊走於力量與清晰之間，從黎明的「起床號角」、訴說「未竟之愛」的葬禮進行曲，到刺激的狩獵場景，最終抵達終樂章燦爛而歡騰的慶典。音樂會先由赫姆森演奏莫扎特C小調第二十四鋼琴協奏曲，《BBC音樂雜誌》盛讚他擁有「清澈通透的音色」，其演繹將為樂曲注入優雅與內涵。
events.overviewEn: Bruckner’s Romantic Symphony unfolds as a vivid tapestry of medieval imagery. Known for his intelligence, confidence and uncompromising respect for the score, Peltokoski brings a fresh yet deeply grounded approach to Bruckner’s expansive vision, allowing the music’s long-breathed architecture to speak with natural authority. With the HK Phil, the newly appointed Music Director balances power and clarity, from the dawn’s “reveille” and the funeral march of “unrequited love” to the great hunt, culminating in a radiant, festive finale. The programme opens with Mozart’s Piano Concerto no. 24 in C minor, performed by Martin Helmchen, a pianist praised by BBC Music Magazine for his “wonderfully limpid piano tone”, bringing elegance and depth to one of Mozart’s most searching concertos.

events.address: Ko Shan Theatre (New Wing Auditorium), Hong Kong
events.overview:
香港八和會館第五度成為油麻地戲院的「場地伙伴」。本年度進行革新，正式易名為「優越新秀粵劇傳承計劃」。由本地粵劇名伶王超群女士、梁兆明先生、陳咏儀女士、陳鴻進先生、新劍郎先生及龍貫天先生擔任藝術總監，肩負起培訓優越新秀演員的使命。以過往14年演出培訓經驗作基礎，聚焦培育40多名優越新秀。透過藝術總監執手指導、長劇演出、新秀展演等全方位訓練，配以一系列培訓課程培育粵劇新秀成長，向觀眾展示香港粵劇新秀演員的實力，將這項本土非物質文化遺產發揚光大。計劃正邁向令人期待的革新，本年度將籌辦66場粵劇演出及活動，展示粵劇文化及藝術風采。

「恩和愛一朝掃，夫和婦休相願」
華雲龍為剷除陳友諒勢力，假冒張仁過邦娶其女銀屏公主。誰知一不小心弄假成真，互生情愫。然而背負一國興亡的雲龍，豈能為兒女私情，忘記國家大業？最終雲龍於棃山一戰計殺友諒。愛侶忽變殺父仇人，銀屏氣憤興兵攻城，卻不幸受傷。雲龍追妻至破廟，甘願任由宰割。到底銀屏要如何抉擇？
events.overviewEn:
The Chinese Artists Association of Hong Kong has been appointed as the venue partner for the Yau Ma Tei Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme for the fifth time. This year marks a significant revitalization as the initiative is officially renamed "Elite Young Talents Cantonese Opera Legacy Program."

Renowned Cantonese opera artists Ms. Wong Chiu-kwan, Mr. Leung Siu-ming, Ms. Chan Wing-yee, Mr. Roger Chan, Mr. Sun Kim-long, and Mr. Loong Koon-tin serve as Artistic Directors, shouldering the mission of training exceptional young performers. Building upon 14 years of performance and training experience, the program focuses on nurturing over 40 elite young talents.

Through comprehensive training—including direct mentorship from the Artistic Directors, full-length opera performances, Young Talent Showcases, and a series of training courses—the program aims to foster the growth of rising stars.…

events.overview: 《止戈為武》是一部融合中華武術和美妙樂韻的原創合家歡音樂劇。演出以「以武入樂，以樂全心」為核心思想，透過動人的旋律、震撼的武打場面和溫馨幽默的劇情，傳遞「以武止戈、以和為貴」的傳統智慧。劇中武術剛柔並濟，巧妙結合音樂與舞蹈，呈現力量與慈悲兩種理念的平衡；音樂創作則融匯國樂精髓與現代編曲，既有激昂的武打配樂，也有溫馨的親子對唱，令不同年齡的觀眾產生共鳴。本劇以視聽盛宴承載文化內涵，寓教於樂，適合全家欣賞。這個計劃亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/ccpo/index.html。如遇特殊情況，主辦機構保留更換節目、表演者、講者及導師的權利。
events.overviewEn: 'The True Martial Way' is an original family musical that fuses Chinese martial arts with captivating melodies. Guided by the core principle of "integrating martial arts into music and filling the heart with music", the performance presents touching tunes, striking martial arts scenes and a warm and humorous plot to convey the traditional Chinese wisdom of "ending conflict through martial arts and valuing harmony above all". The performance showcases martial arts that balance strength with grace, strength with softness, blending music and dance to illustrate the harmony between the philosophies of power and compassion. The music integrates traditional Chinese music with modern arrangements, featuring uplifting martial fight scores as well as tender parent-child duets which resonate with audiences of all ages. It is a feast for the senses, a carrier of cultural essence, and an…

events.titleEn: Hong Kong City Hall Venue Partnership Scheme: "Great Piano Concertos": Sunwook Kim & Beethoven
events.address: Hong Kong City Hall (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
指揮/鋼琴 金善昱 Sunwook Kim

節目
貝多芬
C小調第三鋼琴協奏曲，作品37

貝多芬
F大調第六交響曲，作品68，「田園」

韓國鋼琴名家金善昱載譽回歸，他將以雙重身份登上舞台，以指揮兼鋼琴獨奏身份與香港小交響樂團一起演繹兩首貝多芬劃時代鉅作。2006年以年僅18歲之齡及首位亞洲人勇奪利茲國際鋼琴大賽冠軍的金善昱，以深刻細膩的音樂觸覺和宏大的藝術視野享譽國際，近年他的指揮事業同時如日方中，2021年，他首次執棒指揮KBS交響樂團，翌年獲邀指揮首爾愛樂樂團，並於2024/2025樂季擔任京畿愛樂樂團音樂總監。

音樂會上，他將指揮及演奏貝多芬充滿戲劇張力的第三鋼琴協奏曲，展現作曲家由古典邁向浪漫時期的革新精神；下半場則帶領樂團奏響充滿生命力的第六交響曲「田園」，以潺潺溪流、鄉間舞曲與風暴過後的寧靜景致，勾勒出作曲家對大自然的熱愛與讚頌，一起走進貝多芬激情與恬靜交織的音樂世界。

events.title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：大師神韻
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: The Spirit of the Masters
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
繼往年於廣州星海音樂廳演出的熱烈迴響，今年11月樂團再次獲邀， 於「 粵港澳大灣區文化藝術節 」中演出「 大師神韻 — 香港中樂團經典國風音樂會」，延續粵港文化藝術交流。

「 大師神韻」 立足於深厚的歷史傳統，以人文、文學與戲曲為經緯，集中呈獻趙季平、王立平、閻惠昌及賈達群四位大師的經典力作。這些作品既是音樂大師們長期積累與思考的結晶，亦展現了傳統中樂在當代巨匠筆下的創造性轉化與創新發展。

《國風 》由被譽為「 樂壇神筆 」 的趙季平先生創作。作品以傳統琴曲《 梅花三弄》 的主題為動機，在豐富變幻的和聲色彩中雙主題靈動變奏相互交織，既包含悲苦與困頓，更多的是忍耐與堅韌、奮進與抗爭，以此弘揚國風，展現中華神韻。

《王立平之紅樓夢大提琴隨想曲》中樂版將於廣州星海音樂廳世界首演，及後香港場音樂會迎來香港首演。王立平先生創作的《 紅樓夢》音樂已成為幾代人心中不可替代的文化記憶，更被譽為「 二十世紀華人音樂經典」。本次演出由大提琴家李垂誼與黃學揚共同編曲、李垂誼擔綱獨奏，以一中一西的對話勾勒紅樓悲喜，重塑文學與音樂的共生關係。

賈達群的《 隨想曲．梨園竹調》 將梨園聲韻的悠揚明快融化在昆風曲調的隨想中。透過古老竹笛演繹出寧靜悠遠、靈巧玄妙的旋律，樂曲不僅講述了梨園戲班台上台下的悲歡離合，色彩斑斕的和聲更描繪出華夏神州塞北江南的絢麗景色。

於廣州星海音樂廳演出的《線狂》為閻惠昌全新創作的民族管弦樂，以其家鄉陜西合陽縣獨有的提線木偶戲曲劇種「 線腔」為創作主題，加入鼓板懷、皮弦胡及演唱等，充滿濃烈陝西韻味。這次表演邀請陝西合陽縣線腔木偶劇團皮弦胡、鼓板懷演奏家王坤，以一人之力演奏七種傳統樂器。香港場的三弦協奏曲《儺》 同由閻惠昌創作。儺祭作為中國古代三大宗教禮儀之一，在民間流傳久遠，至今猶見。作品以三弦獨特粗獷的音色調動各種音樂手法，以純音樂形式展現民間儺祭的生動場面。這首難得的三弦大型作品在音色與技巧上皆作出了大膽的新嘗試。
events.overviewEn:
Following the enthusiastic response to its past performances at the Xinghai Concert Hall in Guangzhou, HKCO has been invited again this November to present “The Spirit of the Masters” at the “GBA Culture and Arts Festival”, continuing the cultural and artistic exchanges between Guangdong and Hong Kong. “The Spirit of the Masters” interweaves history with culture, literature and Xiqu, featuring masterpieces by four illustrious composers — Zhao Jiping, Wang Liping, Yan Huichang and Jia Daqun — representing consummate artistic excellence.

Zhao’s Guo Feng ingeniously quotes the ancient tune Three Variations on Plum Blossom, building two sets of variations, adding ever-changing harmonic colours expressing not only sorrow and hardship but also endurance and resilience.

This concert marks the world premiere of the Chinese orchestra version of Wang Liping’s The Dream of the Red Chamber…

events.overview: 《止戈為武》是一部融合中華武術和美妙樂韻的原創合家歡音樂劇。演出以「以武入樂，以樂全心」為核心思想，透過動人的旋律、震撼的武打場面和溫馨幽默的劇情，傳遞「以武止戈、以和為貴」的傳統智慧。劇中武術剛柔並濟，巧妙結合音樂與舞蹈，呈現力量與慈悲兩種理念的平衡；音樂創作則融匯國樂精髓與現代編曲，既有激昂的武打配樂，也有溫馨的親子對唱，令不同年齡的觀眾產生共鳴。本劇以視聽盛宴承載文化內涵，寓教於樂，適合全家欣賞。這個計劃亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/ccpo/index.html。如遇特殊情況，主辦機構保留更換節目、表演者、講者及導師的權利。
events.overviewEn: 'The True Martial Way' is an original family musical that fuses Chinese martial arts with captivating melodies. Guided by the core principle of "integrating martial arts into music and filling the heart with music", the performance presents touching tunes, striking martial arts scenes and a warm and humorous plot to convey the traditional Chinese wisdom of "ending conflict through martial arts and valuing harmony above all". The performance showcases martial arts that balance strength with grace, strength with softness, blending music and dance to illustrate the harmony between the philosophies of power and compassion. The music integrates traditional Chinese music with modern arrangements, featuring uplifting martial fight scores as well as tender parent-child duets which resonate with audiences of all ages. It is a feast for the senses, a carrier of cultural essence, and an…

events.title: 亞藝無疆 2026：亞裔藝采+
events.titleEn: Asia+ Festival 2026: Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances+
events.place: 香港文化中心 (露天廣場)
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Piazza), Hong Kong
events.overview: 今年「亞裔藝采+」以「禮意綻放」為主題，以禮相聚，以藝傳情，共譜文化共鳴，綻放多元民族的獨特風采。讓音樂與舞步化作祝福，每一段演出猶如一份精心呈上的無形禮物，承載不同文化的底蘊，讓觀眾感受不同文化中溫暖而真誠的情感。現場更設有文化攤位與工作坊，呈獻各國精緻工藝與特色小食，向觀眾送上來自不同民族的誠摯心意。
events.overviewEn: With the theme "Blessings in Full Bloom", this year's AECP+ unity through ritual and emotion through art, creating cultural resonance and showcasing vibrant spirit of diverse ethnic groups. Transforming music and dance into blessings, each performance unfolds like a thoughtfully presented intangible gift. Carrying the essence of different cultures, the performances allow audiences to experience the warm and sincere emotions deeply rooted in diverse traditions.

events.title: 2026 香港青年音樂匯演 – 交響樂團匯演
events.titleEn: 2026 Hong Kong Youth Music Interflows – Symphony Orchestra Interflow
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
由音樂事務處主辦，香港青年音樂匯演每年11至12月期間舉行，通過中樂團、交響樂團、管樂團及弦樂團匯演交流，讓學校隊伍互相觀摩切磋樂藝。匯演邀請客席音樂家就參演隊伍的表現提供專業意見，以助提高同學的演奏水平。參演隊伍可獲頒獎項以資鼓勵。

交響樂團匯演分四組進行，包括小學A組、小學B組、中學A組及中學B組。今年有近60隊學校隊伍參加交響樂團匯演。

交響樂團匯演是2026年「青年節@HK」節目之一。

交響樂團匯演（小學組）每人每次限購2張門票。
events.overviewEn:
Organised by the Music Office, the Hong Kong Youth Music Interflows is an annual inter-school event held in November and December. It facilitates mutual exchange among the Chinese orchestras, symphony orchestras, symphonic bands and string orchestras. The participating groups will receive comments from professional musicians. Awards are presented to participating groups for encouragement.

The Symphony Orchestra Interflow is arranged in 4 classes: Primary School Class A, Primary School Class B, Secondary School Class A and Secondary School Class B. Around 60 school orchestras will take part in the Symphony Orchestra Interflow this year.

The Symphony Orchestra Interflow is one of the programmes of the 2026 youthfest@HK.

Maximum 2 tickets per purchase per person for the Primary School Classes of Symphony Orchestra Interflow.

events.title: 「東九開箱2026」沉浸式互動聲光派對《電音迷想》
events.titleEn: Unbox EKCC 2026: Immersive and Interactive Electro Live Concert "IMMERSION
events.address: East Kowloon Cultural Centre (The Turns), Hong Kong
events.overview:
「打」成一片．跳爆舞池！

在這裡，觀眾不只是旁觀者，更有份參與演出！

《電音迷想》是法國音樂人 Verlatour 帶來的沉浸式互動演出；他巧妙融合電子享樂主義與現代合成器浪潮風格，建構出一個既面向舞池又激發無限想像力的復古未來主義世界。

透過即時立體點雲捕捉（3D point-cloud capture）技術，觀眾當下的一舉手、一投足將被即時化成投影融入沉浸式舞台空間之中。台邊的發光互動電子鼓墊則讓觀眾親手擊打出節拍和旋律，與藝術家一同創作，成為樂曲的一部分；觀眾亦有機會可操控場內的互動控制台，改變聲效、燈光和影像，一起塑造演出的走向。你準備好體驗現場互動表演的魅力了嗎？

---

events.overviewEn:
Bang It · Move It!

Here, the audience isn't just watching the show: they're as much an actor in it as they are a spectator.

---

The presenter reserves the right to substitute artists and change the programme should unavoidable circumstances make it necessary

The content of this programme does not represent the views of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department
IMMERSION is an interactive and participative live performance by French musician Verlatour, who blends electronic hedonism with modern synthwave — a whole retro-futuristic universe that gazes equally toward the dancefloor and the imagination.

Through real-time 3D point-cloud capture, every movement and gesture from the audience is transformed into projections and woven into the immersive scenographic space. Illuminated interactive drum pads at the edge of the stage let the audience create melodic and rhythmic sequences…

events.title: 上環文娛中心場地夥伴計劃︰大歷史話劇《萬曆十五年》
events.titleEn: Sheung Wan Civic Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: 1587, A Year of No Significance
events.address: Sheung Wan Civic Centre (Theatre), Hong Kong
events.overview:
明朝萬曆年間六個人物．六種戲劇形式

1587年，明朝萬曆十五年 — 在傳統史學家眼中平淡無奇的一年，卻是歷史學家黃仁宇筆下揭開中國數百年衰落宿命的關鍵切入點。2026年，進念．二十面體再把《萬曆十五年》搬上舞台，配合升級藝術科技，帶領觀眾重新審視萬曆皇帝、張居正、申時行、海瑞、戚繼光、李贄這六位歷史人物在1587年的命運交織。當一個龐大的國家試圖以道德取代技術與法律，國家的崩潰是否為歷史的必然？一場關於權力、命運與帝國沉默告別的劇場盛宴，等你親身見證。

改編黃仁宇同名著作
承蒙Jefferson Huang授權

創作團隊
原著：黃仁宇
導演：胡恩威
改編：張建偉、胡恩威
形象設計：張叔平

events.overviewEn: The year 1587 was a seemingly uneventful and bland year. Shen Shih-hsing the First Grand Secretary, managed to keep things in order. Yet, the period was not as peaceful as it seemed. The previous Grand Secretary Chang Chu-cheng was overthrown by the court officials and his ten-year reform went wasted. Even the general Ch’i Chi-kuang was dismissed though he had established himself for his success in suppressing Japanese pirates. Hai Jui, the eccentric official who was forced to retire earlier, was reappointed to public service. All the partisan and court politics had crippled the efficiency of the bureaucracy. The once ambitious Emperor Wanli, was now weighed down by the ceremonial court proceedings and the feud between the rival partisans. He became cynical, refused to see his courtiers, and neglected his imperial duties. The empire was paralysed by the inadequacies of the political…

events.overview:
「乒乓球，是只有『一瞬間』的運動！」

大專學界展開了一場意想不到的對決——過氣天才潘浩德歸來，迎戰港隊成員張立君，誓要扭轉力不從心的人生！隨著熱血新人歐陽毅恆出現，大學最後一年波瀾四起，就連好友陳家明的球痴之魂也被喚醒！日常時光飛逝，一如高速閃現的乒乓來回，恍神之間已到關鍵時刻。在球場上交錯的四人，能否把握擊球的一瞬間，跨越人生界限？

《乒乓男兒》磨劍三年，先後獲香港話劇團邀請及自家製作讀劇試演，皆獲大量好評。來到2026年，劇作榮獲中國香港乒乓總會及香港代表隊支持，結合劇場科技，與觀眾一同在這充滿不確定性的時代裡，尋找立足當下、啟迪未來的最強絕招。
events.overviewEn:
"Ping pong is all about an instant!"

An unexpected showdown unfolds at the University Table Tennis Championship: Former prodigy POON is making his return to the court, taking on Hong Kong team player CHEUNG! With the attempt to turn around the days in his pre-graduated year, it all starts from the appearing of the passionate newcomer AU-YEUNG, and also the reigniting of CHAN's oul of a ping-pong nut. Time flies like the ball flashing on the court, the four young men suddenly find themselves at the Match Point of life. Can they seize the instant to open a bright chapter?

“Ping Pong” has earned enthusiastic responses from audiences in its Reading Performance held by the Hong Kong Repertory Theatre and Theatre Formula, and till now, the work is brought to stage with the support of the Hong Kong, China Table Tennis Association and the Hong Kong Table Tennis Team.

events.title: 2026社區文化大使—人木「《止戈為武》合家歡音樂劇」巡迴演出
events.titleEn: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: The People's Theatre "Family Musical 'The True Martial Way'" Touring Performances
events.address: Venues in Central & Western district, Hong Kong
events.overview: 《止戈為武》是一部融合中華武術和美妙樂韻的原創合家歡音樂劇。演出以「以武入樂，以樂全心」為核心思想，透過動人的旋律、震撼的武打場面和溫馨幽默的劇情，傳遞「以武止戈、以和為貴」的傳統智慧。劇中武術剛柔並濟，巧妙結合音樂與舞蹈，呈現力量與慈悲兩種理念的平衡；音樂創作則融匯國樂精髓與現代編曲，既有激昂的武打配樂，也有溫馨的親子對唱，令不同年齡的觀眾產生共鳴。本劇以視聽盛宴承載文化內涵，寓教於樂，適合全家欣賞。這個計劃亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/ccpo/index.html。如遇特殊情況，主辦機構保留更換節目、表演者、講者及導師的權利。
events.overviewEn: 'The True Martial Way' is an original family musical that fuses Chinese martial arts with captivating melodies. Guided by the core principle of "integrating martial arts into music and filling the heart with music", the performance presents touching tunes, striking martial arts scenes and a warm and humorous plot to convey the traditional Chinese wisdom of "ending conflict through martial arts and valuing harmony above all". The performance showcases martial arts that balance strength with grace, strength with softness, blending music and dance to illustrate the harmony between the philosophies of power and compassion. The music integrates traditional Chinese music with modern arrangements, featuring uplifting martial fight scores as well as tender parent-child duets which resonate with audiences of all ages. It is a feast for the senses, a carrier of cultural essence, and an…
events.source: LCSD 康文署 – Presented by The People's Theatre (DATA.GOV.HK)
events.posterCredit: www.facebook.com (og:image)

events.overview: 「節拍部落」邀請你踏上一場獨特的遊牧旅程，感受節拍的力量與西非音樂的魅力。置身於這個充滿活力的部落中，讓環保藝術與深厚的文化氛圍交織，點燃每個人的創意火花。我們歡迎你化身村民，通過鼓樂和舞蹈，全心全意地分享喜悅和表達自我。
events.overviewEn: The Rhythm Tribe invites you on a nomadic journey to experience the power of rhythm and the charm of West African music. This vibrant community sparks creativity through recycled arts and a rich cultural atmosphere. We welcome you to join as villagers to share joy and express yourselves wholeheartedly through drumming and dance.

events.overviewEn:
The Hong Kong Youth Music Interflows is an annual inter-school event held in November and December. It facilitates mutual exchange among the Chinese orchestras, symphony orchestras, symphonic bands and string orchestras.

The Symphonic Band Interflow is arranged in six classes: Primary School Junior Class, Primary School Intermediate Class, Primary School Senior Class, Secondary School Junior Class, Secondary School Intermediate Class and Secondary School Senior Class. The Symphonic Band Extravaganza, featuring the top two Gold Award participating bands of each class, will give a remarkable finale to this interflow.

events.title: 「東九開箱 2026」 fuse*《靈魂》（意大利）
events.titleEn: Unbox EKCC 2026: "Sál" by fuse* (Italy)
events.address: East Kowloon Cultural Centre (The Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
萬物皆流轉，唯變化永恆

從初生至消逝，從生死感知到意識探索，意大利藝術工作室fuse*為生命三部曲劃下最終篇章《靈魂》—— 一部淬鍊超過十載的震撼之作！《靈魂》將視角聚焦生命的邊界，從靈魂窺見並擁抱萬物的無常變化。

fuse* 聯同兩所大學的教授利用超級電腦模擬黑洞周邊的現象，將兩位舞者置身無垠宇宙，在未知中展開旅程。舞者身軀與光影經感測裝置即時交織，一動一靜，皆化為粒子構成流光幻象。配合弦樂原聲與電子音樂的交替互換，引領觀眾感受生命的無盡律動，珍視每一瞬。
events.overviewEn:
Everything is in constant change; and change is the only constant.

Like death, the mystery of a black hole remains impenetrable. After exploring birth and life, the Italian artistic studio fuse* unveils the final chapter of its decade-long “Full Circle Trilogy” — Sál (Soul), a work of profound intensity. In Sál, the focus shifts to the horizon, to the boundary of human life, embracing the notion that everything is in a state of constant transformation, that everything is impermanent.

Developed through a two-year research collaboration with university professors, this live media performance simulates the instability around black holes using supercomputers, immersing two dancers in a cosmic world where journeys unfold into the unknown. Dancers interact with visually stunning lights and shadows in real time, along with acoustic and electronic music, conveying the ever-changing emotions…

events.titleEn: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: The People's Theatre "Family Musical 'The True Martial Way'" Touring Performances
events.placeEn: Venues in Yau Tsim Mong district
events.address: Venues in Yau Tsim Mong district, Hong Kong
events.overview: 《止戈為武》是一部融合中華武術和美妙樂韻的原創合家歡音樂劇。演出以「以武入樂，以樂全心」為核心思想，透過動人的旋律、震撼的武打場面和溫馨幽默的劇情，傳遞「以武止戈、以和為貴」的傳統智慧。劇中武術剛柔並濟，巧妙結合音樂與舞蹈，呈現力量與慈悲兩種理念的平衡；音樂創作則融匯國樂精髓與現代編曲，既有激昂的武打配樂，也有溫馨的親子對唱，令不同年齡的觀眾產生共鳴。本劇以視聽盛宴承載文化內涵，寓教於樂，適合全家欣賞。這個計劃亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/ccpo/index.html。如遇特殊情況，主辦機構保留更換節目、表演者、講者及導師的權利。
events.overviewEn: 'The True Martial Way' is an original family musical that fuses Chinese martial arts with captivating melodies. Guided by the core principle of "integrating martial arts into music and filling the heart with music", the performance presents touching tunes, striking martial arts scenes and a warm and humorous plot to convey the traditional Chinese wisdom of "ending conflict through martial arts and valuing harmony above all". The performance showcases martial arts that balance strength with grace, strength with softness, blending music and dance to illustrate the harmony between the philosophies of power and compassion. The music integrates traditional Chinese music with modern arrangements, featuring uplifting martial fight scores as well as tender parent-child duets which resonate with audiences of all ages. It is a feast for the senses, a carrier of cultural essence, and an…

events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
作為香港中樂團的年度慈善盛會，「 Liza & Friends 摯友樂聚」系列不僅是一場音樂的慶典，更是一次愛心與社會責任的深度連結。邁入第八屆，汪明荃小姐與曾鈺成先生將分別以籌款委員會主席與聯合主席的身份，率領一眾社會賢達與樂團摯友，用悠揚樂韻傳遞溫暖，為樂團的發展及社會公益事業籌募經費。

本場音樂會彰顯了「藝術回饋社會」的精神。汪明荃小姐多年來積極參與慈善與公益活動，她對藝術的執著與對社會的關懷，在舞台上化作動人的旋律。今年，多位來自政商及文化界的知名人士已確定傾力加盟，包括戴世豪、陳培甡、鄔友正、劉石佑、蔡德儀、甄美薇、李惠雄、周詠璇及謝雪心。阿姐將聯同這群善心摯友，以精湛才藝共譜溫馨動人的樂章；演出亦將精選多首跨越時代的經典名曲，從大氣磅礴的家國情懷到婉約動人的宋詞改編，帶來多元豐富的聽覺饗宴。

音樂的力量在於其能跨越藩籬、凝聚人心。透過「 摯友樂聚」 這個平台，各界人士齊聚一堂，共同支持中樂藝術的薪火相傳，讓音樂成為聯結彼此、回饋社會的橋樑，譜寫出一份珍貴而深刻的摯友真情。
events.overviewEn:
As the HKCO’s flagship charity event, “Liza & Friends” — now in its eighth edition — is a musical celebration that also attests to compassion and social responsibility. Liza Wang and Jasper Tsang, along with distinguished members of society and cherished friends of the orchestra, use the power of beautiful music to spread warmth and raise funds for the orchestra’s ongoing development and community programmes.

Embodying the spirit of “art giving back to society”, this concert again highlights Wang, a consummate artist committed to charity and community. A host of prominent figures from the political, business and cultural sectorshave agreed to join her on stage — among them David Tai, Calvin Chan, James Wu, John Lau, Lanzy Choy, Salina Yan, David Lee, Charlene Zhou and Susan Tse — showcasing their talents for a heartwarmingevening and musical feast spanning different eras of acclaimed…

events.titleEn: Unbox EKCC 2026: Research and Development Project: "Don’t stop, catch up, walk on
events.address: East Kowloon Cultural Centre (The Lab), Hong Kong
events.overview:
場域特定演出 × 流動影像裝置

當肉身沿著指示前行，現實的邊界將消融於虛擬之中。

由跨媒體藝術家梁基爵策劃，結合虛擬遊戲空間、聲音步行、沉浸式聲效、影像和人類行為的藝術研究實驗，探索數碼時代下「表演」的概念，開發漸進式沉浸體驗的可能性。

東九公共空間將化身舞台，人群動態和環境聲音統統轉化成表演的一部分，構成嶄新的敘事和聲景；實體的演出場地，在媒體的介入下逐步消融於虛擬之中，引導觀眾反思在科技不斷進步的框架下，日常生活如何被重新塑造，人類又如何趕上這場演化。
events.overviewEn:
Site-specific Performance × Moving-image Installation

Physical boundaries fade as bodies move forward.

Conceived by multi-disciplinary artist GayBird, this site-specific performance is an artistic research experiment which challenges the notion of performance in the digital age and exploring immersion as a spectrum, by bringing together virtual game environments, mediated soundwalk, immersive sound, moving images and human behaviour.

EKCC’s public spaces are transformed into a stage – every movement in the crowd, and ambient sounds become dramaturgy, generating a new narrative and soundscape. As media intervene, the physical performance venue dissolves into virtuality, inviting the audience to reflect on how daily life is reshaped under ongoing technological advancement and how humanity keeps up with this evolution.
events.source: LCSD 康文署 – Presented by Leisure and Cultural Services Department (DATA.GOV.HK)

events.overview:
專屬香港的聖誕歷險之旅！

今個佳節，柴可夫斯基的熟悉音樂再度響起，女孩跌入奇幻世界，與觀眾一同展開驚喜滿分的夢幻之旅！為了打敗邪惡老鼠王，主角嘉麗與化身王子的胡桃夾子展開連串驚奇歷險，沿途穿梭於二十世紀初的香港地標，甚至坐上天星小輪，從寒冬一路駛至初春！

港芭年度合家歡聖誕盛事恒基兆業地產榮譽呈獻《胡桃夾子：香港聖誕之旅》連續第六年上演，為大小朋友帶來專屬香港的聖誕歷險之旅。跟着嘉麗從豪華大宅的平安夜派對，一躍至二十世紀初的香港，拜訪奔騰快馬、跳舞點心、艷麗孔雀等一系列繽紛角色，歡慶香港歷史及文化。本土文化與冒險奇想共冶一爐，劇情驚心動魄，舞服及佈景精美絕倫，每場演出都令觀眾感受到冬日的快樂，看得盡興而歸！

製作於2024年先後獲頒聯合國教科文組織「卓越之星」獎及第十二屆「香港精神獎」文化貢獻獎。

「香港人聖誕必看的芭蕾舞劇！」—《星島頭條》
「一部寫給香港的情書。」—《文匯報》

events.overviewEn:
Where holiday dreams come true!

This holiday season, as the lights dim, snowflakes swirl, sugarplums prance and Tchaikovsky’s sumptuous score soars, a young girl enters a whole new world that is as unique as it is magical. In order to defeat the sinister Rat King, Clara and the Nutcracker Prince embark on a fantastical Hong Kong adventure filled with local landmarks and traditions and even board a Star Ferry that takes them from winter into spring!

This revered Christmas tradition is a timeless holiday ballet for the entire family that has been enchanting children and adults alike for generations. From a Christmas Eve party at an opulent mansion to hundreds of colourful characters magically brought to life, including high-octane racing jockeys, dancing dim sum and charming peacocks, Henderson Land Proudly Presents The Nutcracker celebrates early 20th century Hong Kong’s history,…

events.overview:
人人都可以係聖誕老人

隱藏在北極光背後，有一間世界上獨一無二的「聖誕老人學堂」。本著人人都可以是聖誕老人的信念，為每一個有需要的人開特別班，訓練他們學派禮物，做聖誕老人。這一期，班主任蘭子和一眾小精靈，為四位學員特訓。一個大人Alan，三個小朋友丁丁、圓圓、戚戚，因為不同原因，失去了聖誕節。他們覺得現實生活不如意。大人為工作奔波，被誤解；小朋友被忽視、孤獨成長，或者身體有事。他們各有性格，帶着不同目的，學做聖誕老人。經過別開生面但又簡單直接的訓練，他們雖然論論盡盡，但能以真誠面對自己，總算過關。最後，他們明白到聖誕節老人學堂的精神：Heart，Hope，and Happiness。他們都得到一個美好的聖誕節。

events.title: 2026社區文化大使: 東方琴韻藝術團「聽見非遺」華夏正聲 非遺音樂匯萃
events.titleEn: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: Rhythmic East Arts Group 'The Echo of Intangible Cultural Heritage' Ancient Voice of China: ICH Music Collection
events.address: Venues in Kwai Tsing district, Hong Kong
events.overview: 中國古代多次出現中原人士南遷的社會現象，使中原音樂得以傳播至嶺南一帶，並與當地不同風俗與文化融合，孕育出瑰麗多姿的音樂系譜。上世紀中葉的香港接納不同地區的移民在此落地生根，使這座城市成為承載著多元歷史與文化記憶的開放社會，至今仍保存著眾多非物質文化遺產。本計劃將以非遺音樂為主題，在社區展開巡演，旨在承傳、活化與推廣列入香港非物質文化遺產清單的非遺音樂。
events.overviewEn: In ancient China, repeated southward migrations of people from the Central Plains facilitated the spread of Central Plains music to the Lingnan region, where it merged with local customs and cultures to form a splendid musical lineage. In the mid-twentieth century, Hong Kong welcomed immigrants from various regions to settle and take root, becoming an open city that bears diverse historical and cultural memories and preserves numerous items of intangible cultural heritage to this day. This project presents a community tour themed on Intangible Cultural Heritage music to inherit, revitalise, and promote musical items listed on the Hong Kong Intangible Cultural Heritage Inventory.​

一齣跨越語言與年齡界限的無對白作品，以優美的舞台意象，帶領大小觀眾走進充滿無限想像的劇場世界！

旅程由道門弟子對抗風暴的傳說揭開序幕，繼而遇上漂流荒島的求生者，最後潛入夢幻海洋，見證巨鯨與孤獨女孩之間溫柔動人的相遇。作品交織幽默、驚喜與詩意，訴說關於勇氣、選擇、友誼與想像的故事。
events.overviewEn:
*ੈ✩‧₊ Puppetry × Physical Theatre Three vivid episodes brought to life on stage ✧:･ﾟ*

* ꕤꔛ Winner of the Edinburgh Festival Fringe Theatre Award 2025! ꔛꕤ *

A non-verbal performance that beautifully transcends language and age barriers, inviting audiences of all ages into a richly imaginative theatrical world!

The journey begins with the legend of a disciple battling a raging storm, then moves to survivors stranded on a desert island, and finally plunging into a dreamlike ocean, where a giant whale and a lonely girl form a tender and touching bond. Weaving together humour, surprise and poetry, the production tells stories of courage, choice, friendship and imagination.

events.overview:
✧˚ ༘ ⋆｡˚ 新進編舞雙舞作✧˚ ༘ ⋆｡˚

朱仟青《如何建造______》和吳希維《致：》為康文署今年「香港藝術家」系列推出的新進編舞雙舞作節目，為本地年青編舞提供製作機會，支援新進編舞以專業製作規格創作新編中型作品，透過藝術顧問的持續輔導，提升創作質素及製作能力。參與編舞從中獲得完整的專業製作經驗，提升創作及製作統籌能力，建立與不同領域藝術家的合作關係，擴闊創作視野。

《如何建造______》取材自日常工具操作與五金工場勞動，是一場關於身體、技術能力與性別預期相互碰撞的演出，結合任務式動作、材料探索與工場式舞台，呈現女性身體作為具操作性與應變解難的存在。

《致：》探索失去過後的漫長餘震；過去的記憶在生活之間悄然滲入之際，某些東西又正在悄悄溜走，也許是一個人、一段關係、一個曾經的自己。在似乎無法逃離、隨時來臨的告別跟前，我們可以怎樣與之共存？

每場演出全長約1小時15分鐘，包括中場休息15分鐘。

觀眾務請準時入座，遲到及中途離座者須待中場休息或適當時候方可進場/返回座位。主辦機構有權拒絕遲到者進場或決定其進場的時間及方式。

主辦機構有權更改節目及更換表演者。

本節目內容不反映康樂及文化事務署的意見。

Through ongoing mentorship from artistic advisor, the choreographers elevate creative quality, gain comprehensive professional production experience, build collaborative relationships with artists across disciplines, and broaden their creative horizons.

events.titleEn: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: HKCO4U — Passing the Torch
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Studio Theatre), Hong Kong
events.overview:
「 HKCO4U」作為香港中樂團精心打磨的品牌系列，始終秉持「 小而精」的藝術美學，為樂團新秀與青年精英搭建一方施展才藝、閃耀光芒的專屬舞台。本場「 薪火相傳」音樂會，誠邀當代粵樂宗師、高胡名家余其偉先生親臨坐鎮，擔任藝術指導。

演出由樂團畢業於香港演藝學院的青年演奏家擔綱，巧妙點題「薪火相傳」，這不僅是一場音樂會，更是對樂團「 植根傳統、銳意創新、不拘一格、自成一體」十六字藝術方針的生動實踐。他們以「新」生代的青春英氣，演繹源遠流長的「傳」統經典，讓新生代的臉孔與傳統音樂的聽覺享受交融碰撞，編織出一場跨越時空的新舊對話，讓古老樂種煥發出生氣勃勃的時代神采。

韻味深長的廣東音樂和柔美秀麗的江南絲竹，將在這裡融匯共鳴。多樣化的五架頭、七架頭以至硬弓五架頭編制，將立體勾勒出中國南北絲竹樂種的萬千氣象。

樂音之外，現場更將穿插對這兩種樂種特色的深度導賞，引領觀眾在弦索之間領略其背後的深厚文化意涵。誠邀觀眾蒞臨見證，在裊裊餘音中感受那份生生不息的藝術薪火。
events.overviewEn:
Our signature series epitomises the artistic credo of “small but exquisite”, providing a dedicated stage for emerging talents and young virtuosi. For this “Passing the Torch” concert, we welcome the renowned Cantonese musicmaster and gaohu virtuoso Yu Qiwei as Artistic Advisor.

This concert features outstanding young graduates of the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts. “Passing the Torch” here vividly embodies the orchestra’s philosophy: “From traditional roots, to cutting-edge visionary. Embracing diversity and eclectic styles”. Artists with youthful vitality interpret the classics, creating a dynamic dialogue among generations, breathing vibrant contemporary energy into ancient traditions.

The profound charm of Cantonese music and the graceful elegance of Jiangnan silk-and-bamboo resonate together on stage, as diverse small ensemble configurations portray the rich and varied…

events.title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：中國聯通榮譽呈獻：欽米尼亞尼卓夫的胡桃夾子
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: UniCom Proudly Presents: Maxim Emelyanychev Conducts The Nutcracker
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
拉赫曼尼諾夫｜《岩石》，op. 7
莫扎特 ｜C大調第二十五鋼琴協奏曲，K. 503
柴可夫斯基｜《胡桃夾子》選段

「天生的指揮家」（《BBC音樂雜誌》）——俄羅斯指揮家欽米尼亞尼卓夫率領蘇格蘭室樂團初登BBC逍遙音樂節，即以一場「令人難忘、能量澎湃的莫扎特」演出驚艷全場，並獲《衞報》盛讚為「五星級」表現。欽米尼亞尼卓夫不僅是出色的莫扎特詮釋者，同時亦是技藝精湛的鍵盤獨奏家； 這次港樂首演，他將親自擔綱獨奏，演繹莫扎特燦爛輝煌的協奏曲。他並呈獻家鄉俄羅斯的樂曲與之呼應：拉赫曼尼諾夫早期作品《岩石》，蘊含年輕作曲家與其恩師柴可夫斯基之間令人動容的深厚情誼。壓軸之際，欽米尼亞尼卓夫以輕盈靈巧的指揮身姿，在柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夾子》選段中幻化出閃爍魔法，為璀璨節日增添喜悅。
events.overviewEn:
RACHMANINOV | The Rock, op. 7
MOZART | Piano Concerto no. 25 in C major, K. 503
TCHAIKOVSKY | The Nutcracker selections

“Born to conduct” (BBC Music Magazine), Russian conductor Maxim Emelyanychev and the Scottish Chamber Orchestra were hailed as “five-star” by The Guardian for an “unforgettable, supercharged Mozart” performance in their Proms debut. A gifted Mozartian and an accomplished keyboard soloist, Emelyanychev makes his HK Phil debut with Mozart’s glorious concerto, framing it with music from his native Russia. Rachmaninov’s early work, The Rock, encapsulates a poignant connection with the young composer’s mentor, Tchaikovsky. With his buoyant, dance-like physicality on the stage, Emelyanychev conjures up shimmering magic in Tchaikovsky’s delightful Nutcracker selections, perfectly ushering in a sparkling festive season.

events.title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：中國人壽（海外）榮譽呈獻：新年音樂會：愛與再會
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: China Life (Overseas) Proudly Sponsors: New Year Celebration: Amour & Adieu
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
小約翰．史特勞斯｜《酒、女人與歌》，op. 333
法雅｜《七首西班牙民謠》
比才｜《卡門》選段
海頓｜升F小調第四十五交響曲，Hob I:45，「告別」
拉威爾｜《波萊羅》

今年新年音樂會先由小約翰．史特勞斯洋溢慶典歡愉、充滿生活意趣的圓舞曲《酒、女人與歌》醖釀節日氣氛。法雅的《七首西班牙民謠》及比才的《卡門》節奏明快，旋律熱情，使人情緒更加高漲。海頓的「告別」交響曲，以出人意表、妙趣橫生的終樂章，向悄然離去的舊年致意；拉威爾的《波萊羅》則由簡單旋律開始，不斷迴旋的管弦樂織體推向壯麗的終結，精神抖擻地迎接新一年。
events.overviewEn:
J STRAUSS II | Wein, Weib und Gesang, op. 333
FALLA | Siete canciones populares españolas
BIZET | Carmen excerpts
HAYDN | Symphony no. 45 in F sharp minor, Hob I:45, Farewell
RAVEL | Boléro

This year’s New Year concert opens with Wein, Weib und Gesang by J Strauss II, a light-hearted waltz which embodies the effervescent spirit of a festive celebration. The energy grows higher with the vibrant rhythms and passionate melodies of Falla’s Siete cancionespopulares españolas and Bizet’s Carmen. Haydn’s Farewell Symphony offers a poignant nod to the departing year with its surprising and witty finale. Ravel’s Boléro begins with a simple theme, masterfully layering orchestral textures into a hypnotic, magnificent crescendo, in anticipation of an exciting new year.

events.title: 《漢字的奧秘》巡迴展覽
events.titleEn: Mystery of Chinese Writing” Roving Exhibition
events.address: Tuen Mun Town Hall (Exhibition Gallery), Hong Kong
events.overview:
漢字的發展歷程悠久而豐富，從新石器晚期的陶文，至商周時期的甲骨文和金文，再由秦一統後的小篆發展至秦漢間的隸變等。到唐代，漢字的書寫系統已發展成熟，書法藝術更達到巔峰。漢字一直沿用至今，其綿延不絕的生命力，承載著前人的智慧，更體現了中華文化的魅力。展覽將利用簡易的文字、文物圖片及生動的繪畫，向公眾闡釋漢字的發展和文化內涵。

這個展覽亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁https://ccpo.gov.hk/tc。

弘揚中華文化辦公室及中國文字博物館聯合籌劃
events.overviewEn:
The development of Chinese characters has a long and rich history, beginning with the pottery inscriptions in the late Neolithic period, progressing to the oracle bone scripts and bronze inscriptions in the Shang and Zhou dynasties, and evolving through small seal scripts after the unification by Qin to clerical scripts during the Qin and Han periods. By the Tang dynasty, Chinese writing system had fully matured and the art of calligraphy scaled new heights. As of today, Chinese characters continue to embody the wisdom of the past and demonstrates the charm of Chinese culture. The exhibition will use simple writings, images of artefacts and vivid illustrations to showcase the development and cultural connotations of Chinese characters.

The exhibition is also one of the activities in the Chinese Culture Promotion Series. The LCSD has long been promoting Chinese history and culture…

events.title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：太古輕鬆樂聚系列：杜博斯與魔幻的萊格管風琴
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Swire Denim Series: Vincent Dubois and the Magic of the Rieger Organ
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
史特勞斯｜《節日序曲》，op. 61
哈察都量｜《嘉雅妮》組曲
聖桑｜ C小調第三交響曲，op. 78，「管風琴」

盡情沉浸於香港文化中心無與倫比的萊格管風琴聲響世界吧——神聖莊嚴、變化多端、超凡脫俗！巴黎聖母院四位首席管風琴師之一的杜博斯，再度與港樂攜手演出，夥拍屢獲殊榮的指揮伊曼紐爾．捷勒窩利安，上演李察．史特勞斯的《節日序曲》和深受樂迷喜愛、旋律豐富的聖桑第三交響曲，將8,000支音管的音色發揮得淋漓盡致，令人屏息讚歎。居於維也納的捷勒窩利安，親自編彙《嘉雅妮》組曲，展現哈察都量音樂的豐沛能量。
events.overviewEn:
STRAUSS | Festliches Präludium, op. 61
KHACHATURIAN | Gayane Suite
SAINT-SAËNS | Symphony no.3 in C minor, op. 78, Organ

Immerse yourself in the majestic, versatile and otherworldly soundscapes of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre’s magnificent Rieger organ, brought vividly to life by one of the four titular organists of Notre-Dame de Paris, Vincent Dubois. Joined by award-winning conductor Emmanuel Tjeknavorian, Dubois makes a welcome return to the HK Phil with two masterworks for his instrument: Richard Strauss’s Festliches Präludium and Saint-Saëns’s beloved, melody-rich Third Symphony, placing the 8,000-pipe organ in dazzling, commanding focus. Vienna-based Tjeknavorian prepares his special arrangement of Khachaturian’s Gayane in showcasing the high-octane Armenian pulses.

events.overview:
莫扎特｜D 大調輪旋曲，K. 485
貝多芬｜C 小調第八鋼琴奏鳴曲，op. 13，「悲愴」
貝多芬｜降 A 大調第三十一鋼琴奏鳴曲，op. 110
阿爾貝尼茲｜《西班牙組曲》，op. 47（選段）
格拉納多斯｜《哥雅畫集》， op. 11：IV. 嘆息，或姑娘與夜鶯
李斯特｜E大調第二《安慰曲》，S. 172/2
李斯特｜《巡禮之年：第二年》：《威尼斯與那不勒斯》：III. 塔朗泰拉舞曲，S. 162/3

鋼琴巨星郎朗將以他標誌性的藝術風采，呈獻一場兼具深邃美感與炫技光芒的獨奏會。上半場將由莫扎特的機智與優雅出發，到貝多芬「悲愴」奏鳴曲的情感深度，再到晚期第三十一奏鳴曲的澄澈抒情，勾勒出古典鋼琴傳統的演變軌跡。下半場，郎朗將透過阿爾貝尼茲與格拉納多斯的動人傑作，探索西班牙豐富多彩的音樂風景；音樂會最後以李斯特親密內斂的第二《安慰曲》，以及光彩奪目的〈塔朗泰拉舞曲〉作結，為整晚帶來扣人心弦的璀璨終章。
events.overviewEn:
MOZART | Rondo in D major, K. 485
BEETHOVEN | Piano Sonata no. 8 in C minor, op. 13, Pathétique
BEETHOVEN | Piano Sonata no. 31 in A flat major, op. 110
ALBÉNIZ | Suite Española, op. 47 (excerpts)
GRANADOS | Goyescas, op. 11: IV. Quejas, o la maja y el ruiseñor
LISZT | Consolations no. 2 in E major, S. 172/2
LISZT | Années de pèlerinage, Deuxième année: Venezia e Napoli: III. Tarantella, S. 162/3

Superstar pianist Lang Lang brings his signature artistry to a recital of profound beauty and virtuosic brilliance. From the wit and elegance of Mozart to the emotional depth of Beethoven's Pathétique Sonata and the luminous lyricism of the late Sonata op. 110, the first half traces the evolution of the Classical piano tradition. In the second half, Lang Lang explores the rich musical landscapes of Spain through evocative masterpieces by Albéniz and Granados, before concluding with Liszt's…

events.titleEn: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Tarmo Peltokoski Conducts Bruckner 7
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
史特勞斯｜《最後四首藝術歌曲》
布魯赫納｜E大調第七交響曲，WAB 107

布魯赫納憑第四交響曲初嘗成功，同年他動筆創作第七交響曲，作品宛如一座宏偉的大教堂，在靜謐中展現其莊嚴氣度，並透過耐心、平和與從容，凝聚深厚的精神力量。新任音樂總監貝托祺指揮港樂，細緻鋪陳交響曲開首綿長的第一主題──一段彷彿來自自然，或如作曲家所相信，源於上帝的旋律──嚴謹的結構在終樂章圓滿，散發溫暖而堅定的光芒。音樂會以李察．史特勞斯晚年顛峰之作揭開序幕，女高音葛里戈里恩獻唱的《最後四首藝術歌曲》，被《紐約時報》形容為「音色閃耀，深沉而不厚重，能以優雅的清澈傳達內在的疲憊」。
events.overviewEn:
STRAUSS | Vier letzte Lieder
BRUCKNER | Symphony no. 7 in E major, WAB 107

Penned in the same year that the composer’s Fourth Symphony first found success, Bruckner’s Seventh Symphony rises with the quiet grandeur of a vast cathedral, its spiritual strength shaped through patience, peace and poise. With the HK Phil, its newly appointed Music Director draws out the symphony’s arching first theme – a gift of nature or, as Bruckner himself believed, from God – before the work completes its circle in a finale of glowing affirmation. The programme opens with Richard Strauss’s Four Last Songs, sung by soprano Asmik Grigorian. The New York Times writes that her singing reveals “a gleaming timbre, dark but not weighty, (that) expresses psychic depletion with graceful clarity,” bringing quiet serenity to Strauss’s farewell to life.

events.overview:
艾爾加｜《威儀堂堂》第一進行曲，op. 39/1
佛漢威廉士｜《英國民謠組曲》
陳其鋼｜《京劇瞬間》
艾爾加｜E小調大提琴協奏曲，op. 85

大提琴大師馬友友再度登上港樂舞台，演奏深邃動人的艾爾加協奏曲！同場還有艾爾加的《威儀堂堂》第一進行曲──BBC 逍遙音樂節每年必唱的《希望與榮耀之地》旋律便是自此曲──以及另一位重要英國作曲家佛漢威廉士的《英國民謠組曲》。陳其鋼早年師隨法國作曲大師梅湘，《京劇瞬間》參考傳統京劇元素，融合管弦樂技法，聽感層次豐富，展現京劇音樂的色彩。
events.overviewEn:
ELGAR | Pomp and Circumstance March no. 1, op. 39/1
VAUGHAN WILLIAMS | English Folk Song Suite
CHEN Qigang | Instants d'un Opéra de Pékin
ELGAR | Cello Concerto in E minor, op. 85

Cello master Yo-Yo Ma returns to the HK Phil’s stage to perform Elgar’s deeply moving Cello Concerto. The programme also includes Elgar’s Pomp and Circumstance March no. 1 – whose melody is used in Land of Hope and Glory, the must-sing song in the BBC Proms – and Vaughan Williams’s English Folk Song Suite. Chen Qigang studied under Olivier Messiaen in his youth, his work Instants d'un Opéra de Pékin draws on traditional Peking Opera elements and integrates orchestral techniques, creating a deeply textured soundscape woven with the colours of Peking Opera music.

events.title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：格拉斯與約翰．亞當斯生日快樂
events.titleEn: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Happy Birthday Philip Glass & John Adams
events.address: Hong Kong Cultural Centre (Concert Hall), Hong Kong
events.overview:
約翰．亞當斯｜《快速機器的短途旅程》
格拉斯｜第二小提琴協奏曲，「美國四季」
約翰．亞當斯｜《和聲教案》

這場想像與觀感的盛宴，將聚焦於約翰．亞當斯與格拉斯兩位美國作曲大師，展現極致的管弦當代美學與情感張力。格拉斯的「美國四季」由港樂樂團首席王敬擔綱獨奏，啟發自韋華第《四季》，但並無明確標註那段音樂代表個別季節，交由聽眾想像游走於四時流轉之間。港樂駐團指揮廖國敏領導樂團演出《快速機器的短途旅程》，以驚人速度感挑戰極限。《和聲教案》則以層疊有致的管弦織體營造強勁的衝擊力，是二十世紀音樂的重要作品。
events.overviewEn:
John ADAMS | Short Ride in a Fast Machine
Philip GLASS | Violin Concerto no. 2, The American Four Seasons
John ADAMS | Harmonielehre

Celebrating Two Great American Composers

A visceral feast for the senses, this programme pushes the boundaries of musical imagination through the mastery of two important American composers. Jing Wang, Concertmaster of the HK Phil, takes centre stage for Glass’s The American Four Seasons, an evocative work that invites listeners to interpret the seasons through their own imagination. HK Phil’s Resident Conductor Lio Kuokman leads in Adams’s high-octane Short Ride in a Fast Machine and the monumental Harmonielehre, a powerful, immersive journey through intricately woven layers of concentrated orchestral texture.

與港樂一同喜迎新春，投入一場喜氣洋洋的節慶音樂盛會。口琴世界冠軍李俊樂將世界首演高世章特別為他譜寫的全新港樂委約作品《空遊境界》。指揮家錢駿平亦將帶領樂團呈獻一連中國經典樂曲與香港電影音樂，以及尼古拉、譚盾與安納斯古的管弦樂佳作。

(arr. Johnny YIM) | Hong Kong Movie Medley

Conductor Qian Junping leads the orchestra through a jubilant journey of Chinese classics and iconic Hong Kong film music alongside orchestral showpieces by Otto Nicolai, Tan Dun and George Enescu.
